overview: The Army Ordnance Corps (AOC) under the Ministry of Defence, Government of India has released the short notice for AOC Group C Civilian Recruitment 2026.

A total of 2,615 vacancies are announced for various Group C posts including Tradesman Mate (1799), Fireman (508), Multi-Tasking Staff MTS (142), Junior Office Assistant JOA (104), and Material Assistant (50).
Candidates who have passed 10th, 12th, or Graduation degree from a recognized Board/University are eligible to apply depending on the specific post.

The online application process will commence on 24 August 2026 and the last date to submit online applications is 22 September 2026. The written examination is tentatively scheduled for November 2026.

overview: Indian Oil Corporation Limited (Marketing Division), Northern Region Office, IndianOil Bhawan, Yusuf Sarai, New Delhi has released official notification Advt. No. IOCL/MKTG/NR/APPR/2026-27/1 for the engagement of 433 Trade, Technician, and Graduate Apprentices under the Apprentices Act, 1961 across its locations in 9 Northern States and Union Territories.

Opportunities are available for Diploma Engineers (Mechanical, Electrical, Instrumentation, Civil, E&E, Electronics), ITI Holders (Fitter, Electrician, Electronics Mechanic, Instrument Mechanic, Machinist), Graduates (BA/B.Com/B.Sc/BBA), and Class 12th Data Entry Operators (Fresher & Skill Certificate Holders).

There is NO Written Test and NO Interview. Selection is 100% merit-based on marks obtained in qualifying examinations. In addition to the statutory monthly stipend under Apprenticeship Rules, IOCL (MD) Northern Region will pay an extra ₹2,500/- per month towards miscellaneous expenses, plus reimbursement of up to ₹3,000/- for pre-engagement medical examination tests.

selectionProcess: Step 1 - Online Registration: Enrolment on NATS portal (https://nats.education.gov.in) for Graduate/Diploma or NAPS portal (https://www.apprenticeshipindia.gov.in) for ITI/DEO, and applying under IOCL NR Establishment ID.

faqs.question: What is the total number of apprentice vacancies in IOCL Northern Region Recruitment 2026?
faqs.answer: A total of 433 apprentice seats have been announced across 9 Northern States and UTs under Advt No: IOCL/MKTG/NR/APPR/2026-27/1.

faqs.question: Which states and UTs are covered under IOCL Northern Region?
faqs.answer: Delhi (50), Uttar Pradesh (121), Rajasthan (76), Punjab (57), Haryana (37), Chandigarh (30), Himachal Pradesh (22), Jammu & Kashmir (20), and Uttarakhand (20).

faqs.question: What is the selection process for IOCL Apprentice 2026?
faqs.answer: Selection is purely merit-based on the percentage of marks obtained in the qualifying examination (ITI/Diploma/Degree/12th). There is NO written test and NO interview.

faqs.question: What is the stipend structure for IOCL Northern Region apprentices?
faqs.answer: Apprentices receive the statutory stipend as per Apprenticeship Rules (with a portion disbursed via DBT by BOAT) PLUS an additional ₹2,500/- per month paid directly by IOCL (MD) Northern Region for miscellaneous expenses.

faqs.question: What is the establishment ID for applying on NATS and NAPS portals?
faqs.answer: NATS Establishment ID (Graduate & Technician Diploma): NDLSDC000005. NAPS Establishment ID (Trade ITI & DEO): E05200700003.

faqs.question: Is filling the Microsoft Office Form compulsory?
faqs.answer: Yes. After applying on NATS/NAPS, candidates must submit their state and 3 preferred location choices via MS Form at https://forms.cloud.microsoft/r/pw7D2cUK7c before 06.09.2026 (05:00 PM).

faqs.question: Can B.E./B.Tech or MBA graduates apply for this apprenticeship?
faqs.answer: No. Candidates possessing higher professional qualifications (B.E., B.Tech, MBA, MCA, CA, ICWA, LLB) or with 1+ year job experience are strictly NOT eligible.

faqs.question: What is the age limit for IOCL Northern Region Apprentice?
faqs.answer: Candidates must be between 18 and 24 years of age as on 31.08.2026. Age relaxations: SC/ST - 5 years (up to 29 yrs), OBC-NCL - 3 years (up to 27 yrs), PwBD - 10 to 15 years.

faqs.question: What is the closing date for IOCL Northern Region Apprentice application?
faqs.answer: The application portal and Microsoft Office Form close on 06 September 2026 at 05:00 PM.

faqs.question: Is there any application fee for IOCL Apprentice 2026?
faqs.answer: No, application is 100% free for all categories of candidates.

Department-wise break-up: Health & Medical Education Department (421 posts), Higher Education Department (48 posts), Agriculture Production Department (46 posts), and Labour & Employment Department (03 posts).

Major posts include Junior Pharmacist (213 posts), Junior Lab Technician (48 posts), Junior Staff Nurse (47 posts), Horticulture Technician Grade-IV (45 posts), FMPHW (41 posts), Junior Laboratory Assistant (48 posts), Health Educator (15 posts), Sanitary Inspector (14 posts), MMPHW (13 posts), Junior Theatre Technician (10 posts), and Junior Ophthalmic Technician (19 posts).
Candidates possessing J&K Domicile status with 10th, 10+2, Basic Horticulture Training, ITI, Pharmacy Diploma, GNM, or B.Sc Science Degree are eligible to apply.
Online application window will be active on www.jkssb.nic.in from 10 September 2026 to 09 October 2026.

overview: Saha Institute of Nuclear Physics (SINP), Kolkata, an autonomous grant-in-aid institution under the Department of Atomic Energy (DAE), Government of India, has published recruitment advertisement SINP/Estt./Advt./11/2026 dated 31.07.2026.
SINP invites online applications from eligible candidates for direct recruitment and deputation across 62 scientific, technical, administrative, and auxiliary positions.

Total Vacancies: 62 Posts — Scientist 'C' (05), Scientific Assistant 'B' (08), Technician 'B' (18), Assistant Administrative Officer - I (01), Lower Division Clerk / LDC (07), Security Guard 'A' (08), Work Assistant 'A' (11), and Halwai-cum-Cook (04).

Pay Scale & Emoluments: Scientist 'C': Level 10 (7th CPC Basic Pay Rs. 56,100+); Scientific Assistant 'B': Level 6 (Basic Pay Rs. 35,400+); Technician 'B': Level 3 (Basic Pay Rs. 21,700+); AAO-I: Level 7; LDC: Level 2; Security Guard A & Work Assistant A: Level 1; Halwai-cum-Cook: Level 3. Plus DA, HRA, and allowances per Institute rules.

Application Fee: Rs. 500/- for Scientist 'C' and Scientific Assistant 'B'; Rs. 300/- for all other posts. All Women candidates, PwBD, Ex-Servicemen, Deputation applicants, and SC/ST candidates (for posts reserved only for respective category) are EXEMPTED.

Age Limit (as on closing date 15.09.2026): Scientist 'C': Max 33 Yrs; Scientific Assistant 'B': Max 30 Yrs; Technician 'B': Max 25 Yrs; LDC, Security Guard A, Work Assistant A: Max 27 Yrs; Halwai-cum-Cook: Max 25 Yrs. Age relaxation: +5 Yrs for SC/ST, +3 Yrs for OBC, +10 to 15 Yrs for PwBD.
Selection Process: Written Test, Trade/Skill Test, Physical Test, and Interview based on post category.

How to Apply: Apply online at https://www.saha.ac.in/web/job-opportunities by 15.09.2026 (3:00 PM IST). After submission, save PDF application form and email to recruit.staff@saha.ac.in by 18.09.2026.

overview: Ordnance Factory Dehu Road (OFDR), Pune, Maharashtra — a key production unit of Munitions India Limited (MIL), Ministry of Defence, Government of India — has issued Full Advertisement No. 1914/96/AOCP(50)/Phase-II/HRM/2026 for engagement of tenure-based contractual personnel.

Offline applications are invited from eligible Ex-Apprentices of AOCP (Attendant Operator Chemical Plant) trade or its feeder trades for the post of Tenure-Based Danger Building Worker (DBW) in Skilled level.
Total Vacancies: 14 Posts. Category Breakdown: SC - 05 Posts, ST - 02 Posts, OBC (Non-Creamy Layer) - 03 Posts, EWS - 04 Posts (including 05 horizontal vacancies reserved for Ex-Servicemen).
Not Identified for PwBD: The Danger Building Worker post involves handling explosive ammunition materials and is not identified for PwBD (Persons with Benchmark Disabilities) candidates.

Pay Structure & Remuneration: Basic Pay of Rs. 19,900/- + Central DA + HRA (if factory quarters are unavailable) + EPF + Bonus + Risk Allowance. Daily remuneration is calculated @ 1/30th of basic pay + DA for an 8-hour shift.
Tenure Period: Engagement is initially for a period of ONE year, extendable up to a maximum period of FOUR years based on factory requirement and individual performance review.

Essential Qualification: Ex-Apprentices of AOCP trade or feeder trades (IMCP, MMCP, LACP, PPO, Fitter General, Machinist, Turner, Sheet Metal Worker, Electrician, Electronic Mechanic, Boiler Attendant, Mechanic Industrial Electronics, Refrigeration & AC Mechanic) from Ordnance Factories OR Government/Private ITIs recognized by NCVT/NCTVT.

Selection Method: Merit list based on 80% weightage for NCTVT (NAC) exam marks + 20% weightage for Trade Test / Practical Test conducted by OFDR Pune, followed by Document Verification and Medical Examination.
Application Fee: NIL — Absolutely no application fee for any category.

detailsList: Category Breakup: SC - 05, ST - 02, OBC - 03, EWS - 04, Ex-SM - 05 (Horizontal).

Tie Resolution Criteria: In case of equal marks, precedence is given to: (i) Higher marks in NCTVT (NAC) exam -> (ii) Ex-Trade Apprentice of Ordnance Factory Dehu Road, Pune -> (iii) Ex-Trade Apprentice of other Ordnance Factories -> (iv) Older Candidate by Date of Birth.

howToApply: Step 1: Visit the official website of Munitions India Limited at https://munitionsindia.in/career or Department of Defence Production portal at https://ddpdoo.gov.in.
Step 2: Download the official Notification No. 1914/96/AOCP(50)/Phase-II/HRM/2026 and print the prescribed Application Form (Pages 8-11).
Step 3: Fill out the application form completely in BLOCK LETTERS using a blue/black ballpoint pen.

Step 4: Paste a recent passport-size photograph on the application form and firmly paste one extra photo. Enclose two additional self-attested photos with candidate's Name and DOB written on the back side.

Step 5: Enclose self-attested copies of required certificates: (a) Class 10th/SSC Certificate for DOB proof, (b) NCTVT/NCVT NAC Certificate & Marksheet in AOCP or feeder trade, (c) Caste / EWS Certificate in prescribed Central Government format, (d) OBC Creamy Layer Declaration (Appendix-I), (e) Ex-Servicemen Undertaking (Appendix-II) if applicable, (f) Bank account details (cancelled cheque/passbook copy) for SC/ST TA reimbursement.
Step 6: Place the application form and all self-attested enclosures in a envelope.
Step 7: Super-scribe on top of the envelope in bold letters: "APPLICATION FOR 'TENURE BASED DBW (AOCP Trade or Feeder Trade)' PERSONNEL ON CONTRACT BASIS".

Step 8: Send the filled application strictly via Post / Speed Post / Registered Post to: The Chief General Manager, Ordnance Factory Dehu Road, Pune, Maharashtra - 412101 (Tel: 020-27167246 / 020-27167298).
Step 9: Ensure the application reaches OFDR Pune within 21 Days from the date of publication of advertisement in Employment News.

overview: Solid State Physics Laboratory (SSPL), Delhi, a premier research laboratory under the Defence Research & Development Organisation (DRDO), Ministry of Defence, is engaged in pioneering research in advanced semiconductor materials and devices.
Research domains at SSPL include development of compound semiconductors (bulk crystal and epi-layer structure), MEMS, MMICs, acoustic sensor systems, laser diodes, IR sensors, and nanotechnology.
SSPL has released Advertisement No: 625/HR/PaidInternship/2026/M/01 inviting applications from bright final-year students for a 6-month Paid Internship starting Dec 2026 / Jan 2027.
Total Vacancies: 65 seats across Physics, Chemistry, Electronics, Electrical, Material Science, Quantum Technology, Laser Optics, and Semiconductor Device disciplines.

Stipend: Selected interns will receive a fixed monthly stipend of ₹5,000/- per month, paid electronically in two equal installments of ₹15,000/- after completion of 3 months and ₹15,000/- after 6 months.

How to Submit: Duly filled application form along with Character Certificate and recommendation letter/NOC from the Institute (on letterhead with start date clearly mentioned) must reach by POST to Director, SSPL (Kind Attention: HRD, SSPL), Lucknow Road, Timarpur, Delhi – 110054 on or before 30th September 2026.

overview: Local Self Government Department (स्वायत्त शासन विभाग), Rajasthan, Jaipur, has published Advertisement No. 01/2026 dated 27th July 2026 for the massive direct recruitment of 24,752 Safai Karmchari (सफाई कर्मचारी) posts under the Rajasthan Contractual Hiring to Civil Posts Rules, 2022.

A total of 24,752 vacancies are distributed across 183 Urban Local Bodies (ULBs) in Rajasthan, including Non-Scheduled Areas (24,277 posts) and Scheduled Areas (475 posts). Major ULB vacancies include Jaipur (4,811), Kota (1,357), Bikaner (1,084), Jodhpur (890), Udaipur (300), Sikar (480), Alwar (426), Bharatpur (450), and Dholpur (340).

faqs.question: Where can I get the 1-year experience certificate?
faqs.answer: The 1-year sanitation work experience certificate must be issued by a competent authority as specified in the official recruitment notification. The experience should clearly show that you have worked in cleaning/sanitation-related duties for at least one year. Before applying, ensure your certificate matches the prescribed format and issuing authority mentioned in the notification. Submitting an invalid certificate may lead to rejection of your application.

faqs.question: Is a contractor (Thekedar) experience certificate valid?
faqs.answer: It depends on whether the contractor and the experience certificate satisfy the conditions laid down in the official notification. A certificate issued by a private contractor is not automatically valid. Candidates should carefully verify that the issuing authority and the certificate format are accepted by the recruitment rules before applying.

faqs.question: Is sanitation work experience from a government hospital valid?
faqs.answer: If you worked in sanitation or cleaning duties in a government hospital and your experience certificate has been issued by the competent authority in accordance with the recruitment rules, it may be considered valid. The final decision will be taken by the recruiting authority during document verification.

faqs.question: Is experience from a hotel, private office, or private company accepted?
faqs.answer: Experience from a hotel, private office, or private company may be accepted only if it fulfills all the eligibility conditions mentioned in the official notification and is supported by a valid experience certificate issued by the competent authority. Candidates should not assume that every private-sector certificate will be accepted.

faqs.question: Can an NCC or NSS certificate be used instead of the experience certificate?
faqs.answer: No. NCC, NSS, Scout, or similar certificates cannot replace the mandatory 1-year sanitation work experience certificate. These certificates may reflect extracurricular participation but do not count as professional sanitation work experience unless specifically stated in the official notification.

faqs.question: Will selection be through a lottery or a written exam?
faqs.answer: As per the official notification, there is no written examination for this recruitment. The selection process will be carried out according to the procedure prescribed by the Rajasthan Government. Candidates should rely only on the official notification and avoid rumours circulating on social media regarding the selection process.

faqs.question: Is the selection based on money or corruption?
faqs.answer: No candidate should believe or pay money to anyone claiming to guarantee selection. The recruitment process is conducted by the competent government authority. If anyone demands money in exchange for selection, candidates should immediately report the matter to the concerned authorities. Trust only official notifications and announcements.

faqs.question: Should there be a written examination?
faqs.answer: Many candidates believe that a written examination would make the recruitment process more transparent. However, the recruitment process is decided by the Rajasthan Government. Candidates must follow the selection method prescribed in the official notification.

faqs.question: Is the salary only ₹7,000?
faqs.answer: No. The amount of ₹7,000 generally refers to the fixed remuneration during the probation/training period, if applicable. After successful completion of the probation period, employees receive salary according to the applicable Pay Matrix and government rules, along with admissible allowances. Candidates should refer to the official notification for exact salary details.

faqs.question: Will Safai Karamcharis have to clean drains and perform sanitation work?
faqs.answer: Yes. The duties of a Safai Karamchari generally include sanitation work such as cleaning roads, public places, drains, waste collection, and maintaining cleanliness as assigned by the local body. The exact responsibilities depend on the department and place of posting.

faqs.question: Can PWD (Persons with Disabilities) candidates apply?
faqs.answer: PWD candidates can apply if vacancies are reserved for their disability category and they satisfy all the eligibility conditions mentioned in the notification. Candidates should carefully check the reservation details and the list of eligible benchmark disabilities before submitting their application.

faqs.question: Who is eligible to apply?
faqs.answer: Candidates who satisfy the prescribed age limit, required sanitation work experience, and other eligibility conditions mentioned in the official notification can apply. All applicants must also fulfill the document and category requirements specified by the recruiting authority.

faqs.question: Can candidates from other states apply?
faqs.answer: Yes. Candidates from other states can generally apply if they fulfill the eligibility conditions. However, they may not receive the benefit of reservation available to Rajasthan domicile candidates unless specifically provided in the notification.

faqs.question: When will the Rajasthan Forest Guard Recruitment be released?
faqs.answer: The Rajasthan Government has not yet officially announced the next Forest Guard recruitment. Candidates should regularly check the Rajasthan Staff Selection Board (RSSB/RSMSSB) website and trusted job portals for the latest updates.

faqs.question: When will the Rajasthan Jal Vibhag ITI Recruitment be released?
faqs.answer: As of now, no official notification has been released for the Rajasthan Jal Vibhag ITI recruitment. Once the notification is published, details regarding vacancies, eligibility, syllabus, and the application process will be available on the official website.

faqs.question: What is the syllabus for Rajasthan Jal Vibhag ITI Recruitment?
faqs.answer: The syllabus will be released only after the official notification is published. Generally, ITI recruitments include questions related to the candidate's trade, General Knowledge, Reasoning, Mathematics, and basic language skills, depending on the specific post. overview: IIFCL Projects Limited (IPL), a prestigious wholly-owned subsidiary of India Infrastructure Finance Company Limited (IIFCL) - a 100% Government of India Enterprise, has officially announced a rolling advertisement for the engagement of Individual Consultants (IC) on a full-time, contractual basis. With a mandate to deliver expert Financial & Infrastructure Advisory services to Central & State Governments, Local Bodies, and Private Developers across India, IPL is building a robust database of highly qualified professionals. This rolling recruitment campaign operates continuously throughout the year, allowing eligible candidates to submit their applications at any time to be considered for active project requirements in multiple sectors, including roads, highways, ports, power, water supply, renewable energy, tourism, and solid waste management.

This recruitment campaign offers a wide array of opportunities, spanning across 65 specialized consultant profiles. These encompass diverse areas such as Project & Contract Management, Procurement, Financial & Costing, IT & MIS, Digital Public Infrastructure, Legal Management, Corporate Communications, Tourism Development, Master Planning, PPP & Investment, and Environmental Affairs. The vacancies are not fixed to a static count, as hiring is on a rolling basis, meaning candidate requirements are fulfilled dynamically as mandates arise. The position grades range from Young Professionals to Senior Consultants (Grades I, II, and III) based on years of post-qualification experience. Selected professionals will be stationed at IPL's Head Office in New Delhi or branch offices and project sites across various States including Amaravati (AP), Chennai, Ahmedabad, the Northeast Region, and other locations on an "Anywhere in India" basis.

The eligibility criteria vary depending on the specific IC Code of interest. Educational requirements range from Graduate degrees in Engineering (B.E./B.Tech), Architecture, Planning, or Law (LLB/LLM) to Postgraduate degrees, MBA/PGDM, CA, CWA, or CFA from recognized premium national or international institutes. Remuneration is highly attractive and structured based on experience: Young Professionals receive a fixed pay of ₹70,000 per month; Grade I Consultants receive between ₹80,000 and ₹1,45,000; Grade II Consultants earn from ₹1,45,000 to ₹2,65,000; and Senior Consultants (Grade III) are eligible for ₹2,65,000 to ₹3,30,000 per month. The upper age limits are 32, 45, 50, and 62 years respectively.

Interested and qualified candidates can apply either by email or physical post. The application window is open for exactly one year from the date of publishing the advertisement, running on a rolling basis. Candidate selection is based entirely on an Interview process (either in Delhi or via online mode), which follows preliminary shortlisting of applicants matching the company's rigorous experience, suitability, and business criteria. There is no application fee for any category, making this a transparent, merit-based entry into one of India's leading government-backed infrastructure advisory firms.

faqs.question: What is the full form of IPL, and who is its parent organization?
faqs.answer: IPL stands for IIFCL Projects Limited, which is a wholly-owned subsidiary of India Infrastructure Finance Company Limited (IIFCL), a 100% Government of India Enterprise.

faqs.question: What is the main objective of IIFCL Projects Limited (IPL)?
faqs.answer: The main objective of IPL is to provide Financial & Infrastructure Advisory services to various Central & State Governments, their affiliates, Local Bodies, and Private Developers, along with Capacity Building and Policy Advocacy services.

faqs.question: What is the nature of the engagement for the Individual Consultants (IC) positions?
faqs.answer: The engagement of Individual Consultants is on a full-time, contractual basis. Selected candidates are not allowed to take up any other appointment, engagement, or assignment during their contract period.

faqs.question: Where will the selected Individual Consultants be stationed?
faqs.answer: Selected consultants are expected to be stationed at IPL's Head Office in Delhi, and/or any of its branch offices, and/or across various States wherein IPL is currently working or intends to work under mandate.

faqs.question: What does rolling recruitment mean for this IPL notification?
faqs.answer: It means that applications are accepted and evaluated throughout the year on an as-and-when needed basis. IPL maintains an active database of applications, and candidates are selected from this pool whenever vacancies arise in specific areas of work.

faqs.question: What is the duration of the rolling applications window?
faqs.answer: The applications window is open for exactly one year from the date of publishing the advertisement.

faqs.question: What are the four grades of Individual Consultants, and what is their required experience?
faqs.answer: The grades are: (1) Young Professional with 1 year experience; (2) Consultant Grade I with 3 - 8 years experience; (3) Consultant Grade II with 8 - 15 years experience; and (4) Senior Consultant with 15 years or more experience.

faqs.question: What is the monthly remuneration for a Young Professional?
faqs.answer: A Young Professional is paid a fixed monthly consolidated remuneration of ₹70,000.

faqs.question: What is the monthly salary range for a Consultant Grade I?
faqs.answer: The monthly remuneration range for Consultant Grade I is ₹80,000 to ₹1,45,000.

faqs.question: What is the monthly salary range for a Consultant Grade II?
faqs.answer: The monthly remuneration range for Consultant Grade II is ₹1,45,000 to ₹2,65,000.

faqs.question: What is the monthly salary range for a Senior Consultant (Grade III)?
faqs.answer: The monthly remuneration range for Senior Consultant (Grade III) is ₹2,65,000 to ₹3,30,000.

faqs.question: How is the final remuneration decided for selected candidates?
faqs.answer: The final remuneration within the corresponding grade band is decided based on the candidate's expectations, experience, and expertise. The decision of IPL is final and binding.

faqs.question: Is TA/DA provided for official tours during the engagement?
faqs.answer: Yes. Consultants are allowed to undertake official tours as required by their duties, and TA/DA and Hotel Accommodation are paid or reimbursed as per the company's policy.

faqs.question: What are the upper age limits for different grades of consultants?
faqs.answer: The upper age limits are: 32 years for Young Professional, 45 years for Consultant Grade I, 50 years for Consultant Grade II, and 62 years for Senior Consultant.

faqs.question: What are the essential academic qualifications required to apply?
faqs.answer: Qualifications depend on the specific IC Code but generally include regular Graduation/Post Graduation in Engineering (B.E./B.Tech/B.Arch/B.Plan/M.Tech/M.Plan), Master's/Postgraduate degrees, MBA, CA, CWA, CFA, LLB, or LLM from recognized premier institutes.

faqs.question: Are candidates with degrees from foreign universities eligible?
faqs.answer: Yes, provided they can produce an equivalency certificate issued by a Competent Authority certifying that their foreign qualification is treated at par with qualifications offered by Indian Institutes/Universities.

faqs.question: What is the selection procedure for these consultant posts?
faqs.answer: The selection is done through a Personal Interview after preliminary screening and shortlisting of applications based on qualifications, experience, suitability, city preference, and business requirements.

faqs.question: Where will the Personal Interviews be conducted, and is travel allowance provided?
faqs.answer: Shortlisted applicants will attend the interview in Delhi or online. No travel expense reimbursement (TA/DA) is paid for appearing in the interview.

faqs.question: What is the initial period of engagement for these contractual positions?
faqs.answer: Individual Consultants are engaged for an initial fixed period of two years.

faqs.question: Can the period of contract be extended, and what is the maximum limit?
faqs.answer: Yes, the contract can be extended by one year at a time up to a maximum tenure of 5 years (i.e. 2+1+1+1 years), contingent on a satisfactory Annual Performance Review based on KPIs.

faqs.question: How can candidates apply for this recruitment, and are there different email addresses?

overview: The Government Institute of Medical Sciences (GIMS), Greater Noida, Gautam Buddha Nagar, an autonomous premier medical institute under the Government of Uttar Pradesh (established on the lines of S.G.P.G.I. Lucknow), has officially released Advertisement No. GIMS/2026/Manpower/NT-03/10 (dated 09 August 2026) for direct recruitment to 100 Non-Teaching Posts of Staff Nurse (स्टाफ नर्स) through a Computer Based Test (CBT) Examination-2026.

The 100 Staff Nurse vacancies carry a prestigious 7th CPC Pay Scale of Grade Pay ₹4,600/- with Starting Basic Pay of ₹44,900/- per month (Pay Level-07: ₹44,900 - ₹1,42,400) plus admissible allowances under UP Government rules. Category-wise vertical reservation comprises Unreserved (UR: 40), Other Backward Classes (OBC: 27), Scheduled Caste (SC: 21), Scheduled Tribe (ST: 02), and Economically Weaker Section (EWS: 10). Horizontal reservations include 20% for Women (20 posts), 5% for Ex-Servicemen (05 posts), 4% for Divyang / One Leg Affected (04 posts), and 2% for Dependents of Freedom Fighters (02 posts).

Candidates holding a B.Sc. Nursing (4-year course) or B.Sc. Nursing (Post Basic 2-year course) with State/Indian Nursing Council registration, OR a Diploma in General Nursing Midwifery (GNM) with valid registration and 2 years clinical experience in a minimum 50-bedded hospital are eligible to apply. Selection will be made strictly on merit scored in the 100-mark bilingual Computer Based Test (CBT) covering 80% theoretical and 20% practical nursing concepts across examination centres in Delhi/NCR, Lucknow, Gorakhpur, and Varanasi.

faqs.question: What is the total number of vacancies announced in GIMS Staff Nurse Recruitment 2026?
faqs.answer: A total of 100 Staff Nurse vacancies have been announced: UR: 40, OBC: 27, SC: 21, ST: 02, and EWS: 10, along with horizontal reservations for Women (20), ESM (05), Divyang OL (04), and DFF (02).

faqs.question: What are the start and closing dates for GIMS Staff Nurse online application?
faqs.answer: Online application registration opened on 10 August 2026 and closed on 07 September 2026 on the official portal https://www.gims.ac.in.

faqs.question: What is the salary and pay scale for GIMS Greater Noida Staff Nurse?
faqs.answer: Staff Nurses at GIMS Greater Noida are placed in Pay Level-07 with Grade Pay ₹4,600 and starting basic pay of ₹44,900/- per month (₹44,900 - ₹1,42,400) plus DA, HRA, Nursing allowances, and other benefits.

faqs.question: Can GNM diploma holders apply without experience?
faqs.answer: No. Candidates possessing a GNM Diploma must have at least 2 years of experience in a minimum 50-bedded hospital after acquiring the qualification. Candidates with B.Sc Nursing or Post Basic B.Sc Nursing do not require hospital experience.

faqs.question: What is the age limit and crucial date for GIMS Staff Nurse?
faqs.answer: The age limit is 21 to 40 Years as on 01 July 2026. Upper age relaxation of 5 years is applicable for SC, ST, OBC, and up to 15 years for Divyang candidates of Uttar Pradesh.

faqs.question: What is the examination pattern and syllabus for GIMS Staff Nurse CBT?
faqs.answer: The Computer Based Test consists of 100 bilingual MCQs (100 Marks, 2 Hours duration) with 1/4th negative marking. Questions cover 80% theoretical and 20% practical nursing concepts across Section A (60 questions on clinical nursing), Section B (25 questions on allied sciences), and Section C (15 questions on community, ethics & midwifery).

faqs.question: What is the application fee for GIMS Staff Nurse Recruitment 2026?
faqs.answer: The application fee including 18% GST is ₹1,298/- for Unreserved, OBC, and EWS candidates, and ₹944/- for SC and ST candidates of UP. Divyang candidates of UP are completely exempt (₹0).

The recruitment notice was published on 12 August 2026, with district-wise gazette notices issued through the Karnataka Gazette (e-Rajyapatra) portal. rrb-je-dms-recruitment-2026.jobLocation: All India (21 Railway Recruitment Boards across Indian Railways)
overview: Government of India, Ministry of Railways, Railway Recruitment Boards (RRBs) has released the Detailed Centralised Employment Notice (CEN No. 04/2026) for direct recruitment to 3,993 posts of Junior Engineer (JE) and Depot Material Superintendent (DMS) across all 21 Railway Recruitment Boards. (Note: Corrigendum-1 subsequently added 36 posts of Chemical & Metallurgical Assistant, revising total vacancies to 4,029).

Candidates possessing a Three-Year Diploma in Engineering or Bachelor's Degree in Engineering (B.E. / B.Tech / B.Sc in Civil Engineering) in relevant engineering disciplines (Civil, Mechanical, Electrical, Electronics, IT, CS, Automobile, Production, Instrumentation) are eligible to apply. Applicants must be between 18 and 33 years of age as on 01 January 2027.

Selected candidates will be placed in Pay Level-6 of the 7th CPC Pay Matrix with an initial basic pay of ₹35,400/- per month plus Dearness Allowance, House Rent Allowance, Transport Allowance, and other Railway allowances. The recruitment process comprises 1st Stage Computer Based Test (CBT-I), 2nd Stage Computer Based Test (CBT-II), Document Verification (DV), and Medical Examination. Applications must be submitted online at https://rrbapply.gov.in on or before 13 September 2026 (23:59 Hrs).

selectionProcess.description: Screening examination of 90 minutes (120 mins for scribe) with 100 MCQs for 100 marks covering Mathematics (30), Reasoning (25), General Awareness (15), and General Science (30). Negative marking: 1/3rd mark. Shortlists candidates at a 1:15 ratio for CBT-II.

Merit examination of 120 minutes (160 mins for scribe) with 150 MCQs for 150 marks covering General Awareness (15), Physics & Chemistry (15), Computers (10), Environment (10), and Technical Abilities (100). Virtual calculator provided. Negative marking: 1/3rd mark.
Shortlisting at 1:1 ratio based on normalized marks in CBT-II. Scrutiny of original diplomas, degree certificates, caste certificates, and live photo/biometric matching.
Conducted by Railway Medical Authorities to certify fitness under medical standards A-3, B-1, B-2, or C-1 as prescribed for the allotted post.

howToApply: Step 1: Visit the official unified Railway Recruitment portal: https://rrbapply.gov.in or access through individual RRB websites.
Step 2: Create an Account by entering Name, Date of Birth, Father's Name, Mother's Name, active Mobile Number, and valid Email ID. Authenticate identity via DigiLocker or Aadhaar verification.
Step 3: Log in using your credentials, select Centralised Employment Notice CEN No. 04/2026 (JE/DMS).
Step 4: Choose ONLY ONE RRB and indicate your priority order of Railway Zones and post categories.
Step 5: Fill in technical qualifications, select your Exam Group (Civil, Mechanical, Electrical, or Electronics & Allied), and enter academic details.
Step 6: Capture a live photograph directly via webcam or mobile front camera in dark non-white clothing against a plain light background.
Step 7: Upload scanned signature in running handwriting with black ink on white paper (JPG, 30-49 KB, min 140x60 pixels).
Step 8: SC/ST candidates requesting free sleeper class train travel must upload valid caste certificate in PDF format (under 400 KB).
Step 9: Pay the examination fee (₹500 for UR/OBC/EWS; ₹250 for SC/ST/PwBD/ExSM/Women) online before 15 September 2026.
Step 10: Submit the form before 13 September 2026 (23:59 Hrs) and download/print the confirmation slip. Note: An edit/modification window will be open from 16 to 25 September 2026 for a fee of ₹250.
documentsRequired: Class 10th (Matriculation / SSLC) Certificate as mandatory Date of Birth proof.
Three-Year Diploma in Engineering Certificate or B.E. / B.Tech / B.Sc Civil Engineering Degree Certificate with all semester marksheets.
Caste Certificate (SC/ST in Annexure-I format, OBC-NCL in Annexure-II format issued on or after 01.04.2026).
Income & Asset Certificate for EWS candidates in Annexure-III format for financial year 2025-26.
PwBD Disability Certificate (UDID) in Annexure-V format.
Discharge Certificate and pension papers for Ex-Servicemen (Annexure-VI).
No Objection Certificate (NOC) for candidates currently serving in Government / Railways / PSUs.
Valid original Photo Identity Proof (Aadhaar Card, Voter ID, PAN Card, Passport, or Driving License).
importantInstructions: Candidates can apply to ONLY ONE RRB; submitting multiple applications to different RRBs or the same RRB will result in rejection and lifetime debarment.
Negative marking of 1/3rd (0.33) marks applies for every wrong answer in both CBT-I and CBT-II.
Live photograph must be captured at the time of online application; uploading scanned pre-existing photos is strictly prohibited.
Normalisation of marks will be applied for CBTs held in multiple sessions.
Virtual calculator will be enabled on the computer screen during CBT-II.
Examination fee refund (₹400 for General/OBC, ₹250 for reserved) will be credited directly to the Aadhaar-linked bank account upon attending CBT-I.

faqs.question: What is the total number of vacancies in RRB JE Recruitment 2026 (CEN 04/2026)?
faqs.answer: A total of 3,993 vacancies are advertised in CEN No. 04/2026 across 21 Railway Recruitment Boards (UR: 1699, SC: 624, ST: 363, OBC: 913, EWS: 394). Note: Corrigendum-1 subsequently added 36 posts of Chemical & Metallurgical Assistant (CMA), bringing the combined total to 4,029.

faqs.question: What is the educational qualification for RRB Junior Engineer (JE) and DMS?
faqs.answer: Candidates must hold a Three-Year Diploma in Engineering or B.E./B.Tech degree in relevant disciplines (Civil, Mechanical, Electrical, Electronics, IT, CS, Automobile, Production, etc.). For DMS, a Diploma in Engineering in any discipline is acceptable.

faqs.question: What is the pay scale for RRB Junior Engineer?
faqs.answer: Selected Junior Engineers and DMS are placed in Level-6 of the 7th CPC Pay Matrix with starting basic pay of ₹35,400/- per month plus DA, HRA, Transport Allowance, and other Railway allowances (Gross approx ₹55,000 - ₹65,000/month).

faqs.question: What is the age limit and crucial cut-off date for RRB JE 2026?
faqs.answer: The age limit is 18 to 33 years as on 01 January 2027. Relaxations apply: 5 years for SC/ST, 3 years for OBC (NCL), and 10 to 15 years for PwBD candidates.

faqs.question: What is the selection process for RRB JE Recruitment 2026?
faqs.answer: The selection consists of four stages: 1st Stage CBT (Screening - 100 Marks), 2nd Stage CBT (Merit - 150 Marks with Virtual Calculator), Document Verification (1:1 ratio), and Medical Fitness Examination.

faqs.question: What is the application fee and is there a refund?
faqs.answer: The fee is ₹500/- for General/OBC/EWS (₹400 refunded after attending CBT-I) and ₹250/- for SC/ST/PwBD/ExSM/Female/Minorities (full ₹250 refunded after attending CBT-I). Closing date to apply is 13 September 2026.

overview: Power Grid Corporation of India Limited (POWERGRID), a Maharatna Public Sector Enterprise under the Ministry of Power, Government of India, has officially released the recruitment notification (Ref No: Apprenticeship/2026-27/ NR-III /01) for the engagement of Trade, Diploma, and Graduate Apprentices for a 1-year duration under the Apprentices Act 1961.

A total of 25 training slots are notified across Northern Region Transmission System-III (NR-III), comprising 23 positions in Uttar Pradesh across 26 sub-station training locations and 02 positions in Uttarakhand across 3 locations. Eligible disciplines include ITI (Electrician), Diploma (Electrical & Civil Engineering), and Graduate Engineering (B.E./B.Tech/B.Sc in Electrical & Civil).

Selected apprentices will receive attractive monthly stipends of ₹13,500 (ITI), ₹15,000 (Diploma), and ₹17,500 (Graduate) including the Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) component, plus an additional ₹2,500 per month allowance if company accommodation is not provided. There is NO application fee, NO written examination, and NO interview. Shortlisting is done purely on the basis of academic merit in a 1:5 ratio for Document Verification at Regional Headquarters, Lucknow.

overview: Power Grid Corporation of India Limited (POWERGRID), a Maharatna Public Sector Enterprise under the Ministry of Power, Government of India, has officially released the recruitment notification (Ref No: Apprenticeship/2026-27/NR-I/01) for the engagement of Trade, Diploma, and Graduate Apprentices for a 1-year duration under the Apprentices Act 1961.

faqs.question: What is the total number of vacancies in NGEL Recruitment 2026 Advt 04/26?
faqs.answer: A total of 147 vacancies have been officially announced across 8 disciplines: Engineer Civil (43), Engineer Electrical (69), Engineer Mechanical (9), Executive HR (4), Executive Finance (9), Engineer Safety (7), Executive CSR (5), and Executive Rajbhasha (1).

faqs.question: What is the remuneration package / CTC offered for NGEL Engineer & Executive posts?
faqs.answer: The approximate CTC is ₹11,00,000/- per annum (₹11 Lakhs/year), which includes fixed and variable pay components, HRA, Mediclaim coverage for self, spouse, dependent parents & 2 children, and satisfactory service grant.

faqs.question: What is the tenure of engagement in NGEL under Advt 04/26?
faqs.answer: The engagement is on a Fixed-Term basis for an initial period of 03 years, which can be further extended up to an additional 02 years based on organizational requirement and performance.

faqs.question: What is the closing date to apply online for NGEL Recruitment 2026?
faqs.answer: The online application portal closes on 07 September 2026 at 18:00 Hrs. Candidates are advised to complete application submission and fee payment well before the deadline.

faqs.question: What is the upper age limit and crucial date for eligibility calculation?
faqs.answer: The upper age limit is 35 years as on 07 September 2026. Age relaxation is 5 years for SC/ST, 3 years for OBC-NCL, 10 years for PwBD, and as per rules for Ex-Servicemen.

faqs.question: What is the minimum percentage required in qualifying degree for NGEL?
faqs.answer: Candidates must possess at least 65% marks in their qualifying engineering/post-graduate degree from a recognized institution. For SC, ST, and PwBD candidates, the minimum qualifying mark is relaxed to 55%.

faqs.question: What experience is required for Executive (Finance) in NGEL?
faqs.answer: For Executive (RE - Finance), candidates must be a qualified CA or CMA with a minimum of 01 year post-qualification executive experience (excluding articleship period) in Finance/Accounts.

faqs.question: What is the selection process for NGEL Engineer & Executive vacancies?
faqs.answer: Selection involves application shortlisting, an optional Computer Based Test (CBT: 70 Qs Domain + 30 Qs Aptitude), experience scoring (up to 10 marks), and Personal Interview (20 marks). If no CBT is conducted, selection is based on Experience (30 marks) + Interview (70 marks).

faqs.question: Is there negative marking in the NGEL CBT examination?
faqs.answer: Yes. In the Computer Based Test, 1/4th (0.25) of the maximum marks assigned to the question will be deducted for every incorrect response.

faqs.question: Where will the NGEL CBT online exam be conducted?
faqs.answer: The online CBT will be held at 10 cities: Kolkata, Chennai, Delhi, Mumbai, Vishakhapatnam, Gandhinagar/Ahmedabad, Lucknow, Jaipur, Bhopal, and Raipur.

faqs.question: How much is the application fee for NGEL Recruitment 2026?
faqs.answer: General, EWS, and OBC candidates must pay a non-refundable fee of ₹500/-. SC, ST, PwBD, Ex-Servicemen, and all Female applicants are completely exempted from paying the fee.

faqs.question: Can I apply for more than one post under Advt 04/26?
faqs.answer: No. Candidates can apply for only ONE out of the advertised posts for which they are eligible. In case of multiple applications for the same post, the one with the higher application sequence number will be considered.

faqs.question: Are pay slips required to be uploaded as proof of experience?
faqs.answer: Yes. Candidates must upload 02 pay slips per year along with appointment letter, joining letter, confirmation letter, and service/relieving certificates to substantiate executive experience tenure.

faqs.question: Where will the selected candidates be posted in NGEL?
faqs.answer: Posting shall be at any of the Stations, Projects, Sites, Clusters, Joint Ventures, or Subsidiaries of NGEL across India. All posts carry All-India transfer liability.

faqs.question: How many vacancies are reserved for Persons with Benchmark Disabilities (PwBD)?
faqs.answer: A total of 14 vacancies are reserved for PwBD category candidates across engineering and executive disciplines, inclusive of backlog vacancies.

faqs.question: Do I need to send physical printouts of the application to NGEL?
faqs.answer: No. No physical documents or hard copy applications need to be sent to NGEL by post. Candidates should retain a printed copy of the registration slip for future reference.

faqs.question: What are the medical fitness requirements for NGEL recruitment?
faqs.answer: Candidates must possess sound health and will undergo medical examination at specified Government District Hospitals in accordance with NGEL medical standards before joining.

faqs.question: What format is required for OBC-NCL and EWS certificates?
faqs.answer: OBC-NCL certificates must be in the prescribed Central Govt format valid for FY 2026-27. EWS Income & Asset certificates must be valid for FY 2026-27 based on gross income of FY 2025-26.

faqs.question: Can final year students apply for NGEL Engineer posts?
faqs.answer: No. Candidates must possess the final passing degree certificate, consolidated mark sheets, and the requisite 3 years of post-qualification executive experience on or before 07 September 2026.

faqs.question: Where can I apply online for NGEL Advt 04/26 recruitment?
faqs.answer: Candidates can apply online exclusively through the official NTPC Green Energy Limited careers portal at www.ngel.in.

faqs.question: What is the total number of vacancies in Bank of Baroda LBO Recruitment 2026?
faqs.answer: A total of 2,482 vacancies have been announced for Local Bank Officers across 20 States in India.

faqs.question: What is the scale of pay and starting salary for BOB Local Bank Officer?
faqs.answer: BOB LBOs are recruited in JMG/S-I scale (₹48,480 – ₹85,920) with one advance increment granted for 1+ year officer experience, plus DA, HRA, CCA, and bank allowances.

faqs.question: What is the mandatory eligibility criteria for BOB LBO?
faqs.answer: Candidates must be Graduates in any discipline, aged 21–30 years as on 01.08.2026, with a minimum of 1 year of post-qualification officer experience in a Scheduled Commercial Bank, and proficiency in the applied state's local language.

faqs.question: Can a candidate apply for multiple states in BOB LBO recruitment?

faqs.question: What is the service bond and probation period for BOB LBO?

faqs.question: What is the state lock-in posting period for BOB Local Bank Officers?

faqs.question: Is the English section in the Online Test counted for the final merit list?

faqs.question: What is the application fee for BOB LBO Recruitment 2026?

Under this updated notification, the earlier clause regarding ongoing requisitions up to 30.09.2026 has been finalized and withdrawn. PSSSB has officially declared the complete department-wise and category-wise seat matrix for 531 confirmed vacancies (including major allocations in Excise & Taxation with 150 posts, Punjab Mandi Board with 90 posts, DC Gurdaspur with 36 posts, Revenue Department with 25 posts, and multiple District Commissioner offices).

The online application portal has been reopened for fresh eligible candidates from 25 August 2026 to 07 September 2026 (5:00 PM). Candidates who have already applied under Advt. No. 02/2026 earlier do NOT need to apply again. Selection will be conducted via an Objective Written Examination (Part-A Punjabi Qualifying 50% + Part-B Competitive Merit) followed by a mandatory Computer Typing Test in English & Punjabi (Raavi Font at 30 WPM) and Document Verification.

selectionProcess.description: Objective type multiple choice questions exam conducted in two parts on the same day: Part-A is a 10th standard Punjabi Language qualifying test (minimum 50% marks compulsory to qualify). Part-B is the core competitive exam covering General Knowledge, Reasoning, Numerical Ability, English, Punjabi, and Computer Awareness. 1 Mark per question with 0.25 (1/4th) negative marking for each incorrect answer. Merit is determined purely on Part-B marks.

Shortlisted candidates based on written exam Part-B merit will be called for a Computer Typing Test. Candidates must achieve a minimum typing speed of 30 Words Per Minute (WPM) in both English and Punjabi. Punjabi typing will be strictly conducted using the Unicode Compliant Font Raavi. Typing test is mandatory and of Qualifying Nature.

Candidates who qualify the typing test will be summoned for counselling and scrutiny of original certificates (Matric Punjabi mark sheet, Degree certificate, 120-Hr ISO 9001 Computer / O-Level certificate, Punjab Domicile Certificate issued within 5 years, Caste/EWS/ESM/PwD certificates).

howToApplySteps: Step 1: Visit the official website of Punjab Subordinate Services Selection Board at https://sssb.punjab.gov.in.
Step 2: On the homepage, navigate to the Online Applications tab and click on the link for Advt. No. 02/2026 (Corrigendum) - Clerk (Common Cadre).

Step 3: If you are a new applicant, click on Registration, provide your basic details (Full Name, Fathers Name, Date of Birth, Active Mobile Number & Valid Email ID) to generate your User ID and Password. (Note: Candidates who already applied earlier under Advt 02/2026 do NOT need to register or apply again).

Step 4: Log in with your User ID and credentials, fill out personal information, category details (ensure correct Category Code 101 to 121), educational qualifications, and 120-hr computer certification details.

Step 5: Upload your recent passport-sized photograph (or capture live webcam photo) and scanned clear signature. Click Attach Annexure to upload scanned copies of 10th Punjabi certificate, Graduation degree, and Category/Domicile certificates.

Step 6: Click Make Payment to pay the prescribed category fee online via Net Banking, Debit Card, Credit Card, or UPI. After successful transaction, verify all details and click Final Submit. Download and print the submitted Application Form and payment receipt for future counselling reference.

faqs.question: What is the total number of vacancies announced in PSSSB Advt 02/2026 Corrigendum?
faqs.answer: PSSSB has confirmed a total of 531 vacancies for Clerk (Common Cadre) Group-C distributed across 29 Punjab Government Departments, Boards, and District Commissioner Offices.

faqs.question: What are the reopening application dates for PSSSB Clerk 531 Vacancies?
faqs.answer: Online applications are reopened on the PSSSB portal from 25 August 2026 and will remain open until 07 September 2026 (5:00 PM). The last date to pay the application fee is also 07 September 2026.

faqs.question: I already applied for Advt. No. 02/2026 in February/March 2026. Do I need to apply again?
faqs.answer: No. As clearly stated in paragraph 3.0 of the Corrigendum, candidates who have already applied under Advertisement No. 02/2026 earlier do NOT need to re-apply. Their earlier applications remain 100% valid.

faqs.question: What is the educational qualification required for PSSSB Clerk recruitment?
faqs.answer: Candidates must possess a Bachelor degree in any discipline from a recognized university, must have completed at least a 120-hour computer course (or DOEACC O Level), and must have passed Matriculation (10th) with Punjabi as a compulsory or elective subject.

faqs.question: Is the 120-hour computer course mandatory? What institutions are valid?
faqs.answer: Yes, candidates must possess at least 120 hours course with working experience in Personal Computers / IT in Office Productivity or Desktop Publishing Applications from a Government recognized or ISO 9001 certified institution, OR a DOEACC O Level certificate.

faqs.question: What font is used for the PSSSB Punjabi typing test?
faqs.answer: The Punjabi computer typing test will be strictly conducted using the Unicode Compliant Font Raavi at a speed of 30 words per minute (WPM).

faqs.question: What is the typing speed requirement for English and Punjabi?
faqs.answer: Candidates must achieve a minimum typing speed of 30 WPM in both English and Punjabi on computer. Both typing tests are qualifying in nature.

faqs.question: What is the examination pattern and marking scheme for PSSSB Clerk 2026?
faqs.answer: The exam consists of two parts: Part-A is a 10th-standard Punjabi Language qualifying paper (50% marks compulsory). Part-B is the competitive merit paper consisting of objective MCQs. Each question carries 1 mark with 0.25 (1/4th) negative marking for incorrect answers.

faqs.question: What happens if a candidate fails to score 50% in Part-A (Punjabi Language)?
faqs.answer: Securing at least 50% marks in Part-A Punjabi Language test is mandatory. Failure to score 50% in Part-A will disqualify the candidate immediately from the merit list, regardless of high marks obtained in Part-B.

faqs.question: What is the salary / pay scale for PSSSB Clerk Common Cadre?
faqs.answer: The post falls under Punjab 7th CPC Matrix Level-2. Selected candidates receive a fixed initial basic pay of Rs. 19,900/- per month during the 3-year probation period, followed by regular full allowances upon confirmation.

faqs.question: What is the age limit for PSSSB Clerk 2026?
faqs.answer: As on 01.01.2026, the age limit is 18 to 37 years for General candidates, 18 to 42 years for SC/BC of Punjab, 18 to 45 years for Govt employees, and 18 to 47 years for Divyangjan (PwD) of Punjab.

faqs.question: What is the application fee for PSSSB Clerk recruitment?
faqs.answer: General / Sports / Freedom Fighters: Rs. 1,000/-; SC / BC / EWS of Punjab: Rs. 250/-; Ex-Servicemen & Dependents: Rs. 200/-; Physically Handicapped (PwD): Rs. 500/-.

faqs.question: Can candidates from other states apply for PSSSB Clerk?
faqs.answer: Candidates from other states can apply under the General/Unreserved category provided they have passed Matriculation (10th) with Punjabi as a compulsory/elective subject and fulfill all qualification criteria. Reservation benefits are strictly restricted to Punjab domicile holders.

faqs.question: Is Punjab Domicile / Residence Certificate compulsory for reserved category candidates?
faqs.answer: Yes. All candidates claiming reservation (SC, BC, EWS, ESM, Sports, PwD, FF) must produce a valid Punjab Domicile / Residence Certificate that is not more than 5 years old at the time of counselling.

faqs.question: Which departments have the highest number of vacancies in this recruitment?
faqs.answer: The highest vacancies are in Excise & Taxation Department (150 posts: 145 Field + 5 Head Office), Punjab State Agricultural Marketing Board / Mandi Board (90 posts), DC Gurdaspur (36 posts), Revenue & Disaster Management (25 posts), DC Barnala (24 posts), and DC Moga (21 posts).

faqs.question: How will the final merit list be prepared?
faqs.answer: The Common Merit List will be prepared strictly based on the marks scored in Part-B of the written examination among candidates who have qualified Part-A (minimum 50%) and passed the English and Punjabi computer typing test (30 WPM).

faqs.question: How will tie-breaker in written exam merit be resolved?
faqs.answer: If two or more candidates score equal marks in Part-B, the candidate older in age will be placed higher. If age is identical, higher percentage in graduation degree, followed by higher marks in Matriculation will be used.

faqs.question: Can I edit my application form after final submission?
faqs.answer: No. As per PSSSB guidelines, once the application form is submitted and fee is paid, no correction or modification is permitted under any circumstances.

faqs.question: How can I contact PSSSB helpdesk if I face technical issues during online application?
faqs.answer: You can email helpdesk.sssbpb@gmail.com or call office numbers 0172-2298000 (Ext. 5106/5107), 0172-2298083, or helpline numbers 99885-80229 / 9646932955 between 10:00 AM and 4:00 PM on working days.

faqs.question: Where will the exam admit cards and typing test call letters be published?
faqs.answer: Admit cards for written test and typing test will be released exclusively on the official website https://sssb.punjab.gov.in. No hard copies will be sent by postal mail.

overview: Railway Recruitment Cell (RRC), East Coast Railway (ECoR), Bhubaneswar has published a centralized employment notification (Notification No. ECoR/Pers/RRC/Act Apprentice/2026-27 dated 21/08/2026) for the engagement of Act Apprentices under the Apprentices Act, 1961 for the training year 2026–2027.

A total of 1,599 training slots are notified across 25 designated technical and vocational trades in various workshops and divisions under the jurisdiction of East Coast Railway, including Carriage Repair Workshop (CRW) Mancheswar (250 slots), Khurda Road Division (773 slots), Sambalpur Division (262 slots), Rayagada Division (292 slots), and ECoR Zonal Headquarters at Bhubaneswar (22 slots).

Selection will be made purely on the basis of academic merit calculated from the aggregate percentage of marks obtained in Matriculation (Class 10th with minimum 50% marks). There is NO written test, computer-based exam, or personal interview. Furthermore, candidates completing Act Apprenticeship training (CCAA) in Railway establishments holding National Apprenticeship Certificate (NAC) will receive preference for up to 20% of vacancies in open market Railway Level-1 (Group-D, Pay Scale ₹18,000 – ₹56,900) recruitments.

Eligible Indian citizens with 10th Pass (min 50% aggregate) and ITI / NTC Certificate in the relevant trade (or 12th PCB for Medical Lab Technician) can submit their online application through the official RRC Bhubaneswar portal (www.rrcbbs.org.in) starting from 26 August 2026 (17:00 hrs) until the closing deadline on 15 September 2026 (17:00 hrs).

education: 1. General Educational Qualification (All Trades): Passed Matriculation (Class 10th) examination under 10+2 examination system with a minimum of 50% aggregate marks from a recognized Board.

2. Technical Qualification (ITI Trades): Must possess an ITI Certificate (National Trade Certificate - NTC) in the relevant designated trade affiliated to NCVT / SCVT, as per the Apprentices Act, 1961.

3. Medical Laboratory Technician (Pathology): 12th pass (under 10+2 system) with Physics, Chemistry, and Biology (PCB) with a minimum of 50% marks in both 10th & 12th examinations. Mark sheets and passing certificates of both Class 10 and Class 12 (PCB) must be uploaded.
4. Secretarial Assistant & Stenographer: Must possess National Trade Certificate (NTC) approved by NCVT/SCVT in Stenography / Secretarial Assistant trade.

5. Computer Operator & Programming Assistant (COPA): Must possess Broad Base Basic Training in Information Technology Sector under Centre of Excellence (CoE) scheme in repair & maintenance of computer hardware & peripherals OR networking + National Trade Certificate (NTC) approved by NCVT/SCVT.

6. Ineligibility Clause: Engineering graduates (B.E./B.Tech) and Diploma holders are NOT eligible under this notification. Applicants whose Class 10th or ITI results are awaited or who have failed in ITI are strictly ineligible.

selectionProcess.description: The merit list for each unit/division will be prepared solely on the basis of aggregate percentage of marks obtained in Matriculation (Class 10th), subject to a minimum of 50% aggregate marks.

Marks in all subjects mentioned in the mark sheet (including optional, additional, and alternate subjects) will be reckoned for percentage calculation — 'best of five' calculation is strictly prohibited. CGPA must be converted to equivalent percentage.

In case two or more applicants secure identical marks, preference will be given to the older candidate by date of birth. If DOB is also identical, the candidate who passed the Matriculation examination earlier will be placed higher.
There will be NO written test, computer-based examination, or viva voce. Selection is 100% merit-based.
Candidates shortlisted based on trade-wise and community-wise merit will be called for Document Verification at Headquarters of East Coast Railway, Bhubaneswar.
Final engagement is subject to verification of original certificates and submission of Medical Fitness Certificate in Annexure 'F' issued by a Gazetted Doctor (Assistant Surgeon or above).

howToApplySteps: Step 1: Visit the official nodal website of Railway Recruitment Cell, Bhubaneswar: www.rrcbbs.org.in.
Step 2: Locate and click on 'Engagement of Act Apprentices over ECoR for the year 2026–27' (Notification No. ECoR/Pers/RRC/Act Apprentice/2026-27).
Step 3: Register by providing your active email ID, mobile number, and 12-digit Aadhaar Number (or 28-digit Enrolment ID).
Step 4: Fill in personal details, educational qualifications (all subjects aggregate marks), ITI trade details, and choose ONE Division/Workshop carefully.
Step 5: Upload scanned photograph (3.5 cm × 3.5 cm, 20 KB to 70 KB, 100 DPI) and signature (3.5 cm × 3.5 cm, 20 KB to 30 KB, 100 DPI).
Step 6: Upload scanned copies of Class 10th marksheet/certificate, ITI marksheet & NTC/provisional certificate, Caste/EWS/Disability certificate (if applicable).
Step 7: Pay the non-refundable application fee of ₹100/- online (SC/ST/PwBD/Women candidates are exempted).
Step 8: Review all submitted information carefully, submit the application before 15/09/2026 (17:00 hrs), and download/print the finalized application form.

faqs.question: What is the total number of vacancies in East Coast Railway (ECoR) Apprentice Recruitment 2026?
faqs.answer: A total of 1,599 Act Apprentice training slots are notified across Carriage Repair Workshop Mancheswar (250), Khurda Road Division (773), Sambalpur Division (262), Rayagada Division (292), and ECoR HQ Bhubaneswar (22).

faqs.question: What is the official notification number and date for ECoR Apprentice 2026?
faqs.answer: The official notification number is ECoR/Pers/RRC/Act Apprentice/2026-27, dated 21/08/2026.

faqs.question: What are the opening and closing dates for online application?
faqs.answer: The online application opens on 26 August 2026 at 17:00 hrs and closes on 15 September 2026 at 17:00 hrs.

faqs.question: Is there any written examination or interview for selection?
faqs.answer: No. There is NO written test, computer-based exam, or interview. Selection is made solely on the basis of academic merit calculated from the aggregate percentage of marks in Matriculation (Class 10th) with a minimum of 50% marks.

faqs.question: What is the educational qualification required for ECoR Act Apprentice?
faqs.answer: Candidates must have passed Matriculation (Class 10th) under 10+2 system with minimum 50% aggregate marks from a recognized board, plus possess an ITI Certificate (National Trade Certificate - NTC) in the relevant trade affiliated to NCVT/SCVT. For Medical Lab Tech (Pathology), 12th Pass with PCB (min 50% marks in both 10th & 12th) is required.

faqs.question: Are Diploma or Engineering (B.E./B.Tech) degree holders eligible to apply?
faqs.answer: No. Engineering graduates and Diploma holders are not eligible to apply under this notification as they fall under a separate apprenticeship scheme.

faqs.question: What is the age limit for ECoR Apprentice Recruitment 2026?
faqs.answer: Applicants must be between 15 to 24 years of age as on 15 September 2026 (closing date). Upper age relaxation applies for SC/ST (5 years), OBC-NCL (3 years), PwBD (10 years), and Ex-Servicemen as per rules.

faqs.question: How much is the application fee and who is exempted?
faqs.answer: The application fee is ₹100/- for General/OBC/EWS male candidates. SC, ST, PwBD, and Women applicants of all categories are 100% exempted from paying any fee (₹0).

faqs.question: How is the 10th class percentage calculated for the merit list?
faqs.answer: The percentage is calculated based on the total marks of ALL subjects mentioned in the mark sheet (including optional, additional, and alternate subjects). The 'best of five' calculation is strictly not permitted.

faqs.question: What benefit do Railway Apprentices (CCAA) receive in future Railway jobs?
faqs.answer: Candidates who successfully complete Act Apprenticeship training (CCAA) in Railway establishments and hold National Apprenticeship Certificate (NAC) will be given preference for up to 20% of vacancies in direct open market Railway Level-1 (Group-D, Pay Scale ₹18,000 – ₹56,900) recruitments.

faqs.question: Can I apply for more than one Division or Workshop under ECoR?
faqs.answer: No. Applicants are permitted to choose only ONE Division or Workshop. The choice once submitted cannot be changed.

faqs.question: Can a candidate possessing ITI in multiple trades apply separately?
faqs.answer: Yes. Applicants possessing ITI qualifications in more than one trade may apply separately for each relevant trade.

faqs.question: Where will the Document Verification (DV) be conducted?
faqs.answer: Document Verification for all shortlisted candidates across all units will take place centrally at the Headquarters of East Coast Railway, Bhubaneswar, Odisha.

faqs.question: What are the photo and signature upload specifications?
faqs.answer: Photograph: Recent colour photo, 3.5 cm × 3.5 cm, 20 KB to 70 KB, 100 DPI in JPG/JPEG format (taken within 3 months, clear front view without cap/goggles). Signature: 3.5 cm × 3.5 cm, 20 KB to 30 KB, 100 DPI.

faqs.question: What is the date of issue requirement for OBC-NCL certificate?
faqs.answer: OBC-NCL certificates must be issued on or after 01/04/2026 in the prescribed Central Government format (Annexure 'C') along with a Self-Declaration form (Annexure 'D').

faqs.question: Will hostel accommodation be provided during apprenticeship training?
faqs.answer: No. No hostel accommodation is provided during training. Apprentices must make their own boarding and lodging arrangements.

faqs.question: Does completion of apprenticeship guarantee permanent employment in Railways?
faqs.answer: No. As per the Apprentices Act, 1961, it is not obligatory for Railways to offer permanent employment upon training completion. However, CCAA holders get up to 20% quota/preference in Railway Level-1 direct recruitments.

faqs.question: What is the stipend paid during apprenticeship training?
faqs.answer: Selected apprentices will be paid a monthly stipend at the prescribed rates as per the Apprentices Act, 1961 and Railway Board directives issued from time to time.

faqs.question: What are the minimum physical standards required?
faqs.answer: Height: minimum 137 cm, Weight: minimum 25.4 kg, Chest expansion: not less than 3.8 cm, Visual Acuity: Bee-One standard (6/9, 6/12 with or without glasses).

overview: Department of Women, Child, Disabled and Senior Citizens Welfare (WDCW), Rangareddy District, Government of Telangana has officially released the recruitment notification (File No. 359/ICDS/2026) on 29 August 2026 inviting online applications from eligible local female candidates for filling 125 Anganwadi Teacher (AWT) vacancies across 7 ICDS projects in the district.

The 125 vacancies are distributed across seven Integrated Child Development Services (ICDS) projects: Amangal (31 Posts), Chevella (29 Posts), Hayathnagar (3 Posts), Ibrahimpatnam (21 Posts), Maheshwaram (10 Posts), Serilingampally (5 Posts), and Shadnagar (26 Posts). Appointed Anganwadi Teachers will receive a monthly honorarium of ₹13,650/- per month along with government benefits.

Eligible local married female candidates who have passed SSC (10th Class) can submit their online applications through the official WDCW recruitment portal at https://mis.tgwdcw.in/ or http://wdcw.tg.nic.in from 31 August 2026 to 10 September 2026 (5:00 PM).

education: Passed SSC (Class 10th) examination from the Board of Secondary Education, Telangana State or equivalent recognized Board.
The applicant MUST be a local resident of the concerned village / Gram Panchayat / Municipal Ward in which the Anganwadi Centre is situated.
Must be a married woman (Widows, Divorced women, and Destitute deserted women holding valid legal certificates are eligible with preference as per rules).
Must possess sound knowledge and fluency in Telugu language.
eligibility.ageLimit: 21 to 35 years as on 01.07.2026. For SC/ST candidates residing in tribal/agency areas, the minimum age requirement is 18 years.
medicalStandards: Must be physically and mentally active to manage children, conduct pre-school education, and maintain health & nutrition registers.

salary.allowances: Plus annual uniform allowance, incentive allowances for Poshan Abhiyaan mobile tracking, and standard maternity benefits as admissible under Telangana State rules.

selectionProcess.description: Candidate submits online application along with proof of local residence issued by Tahsildar / MRO.
Scrutiny of 10th marks, age criteria, marital status, and category reservation points.
Original certificate verification conducted under the chairmanship of District Collector / District Welfare Officer, Rangareddy.
Issuance of appointment order and posting at the respective Anganwadi Center.

howToApplySteps: Step 1: Visit the official Telangana Women & Child Development online application portal at https://mis.tgwdcw.in or http://wdcw.tg.nic.in.
Step 2: Locate the notification 'AWT Recruitment 2026 - Rangareddy District' (File No. 359/ICDS/2026).

Step 3: Select 'Rangareddy' district, choose the specific ICDS Project (Amangal, Chevella, Hayathnagar, Ibrahimpatnam, Maheshwaram, Serilingampally, or Shadnagar), and select your local Anganwadi Centre (AWC).
Step 4: Fill in personal details, date of birth, marital status, husband's name, caste/community (SC/ST/BC/EWS/OC), and SSC 10th marks.
Step 5: Upload scanned self-attested copies of SSC memo, local residence certificate (from Tahsildar/MRO), caste certificate, marriage proof, and passport photo.
Step 6: No application fee is payable. Review all entries and submit the online application form before 10 September 2026 (05:00 PM).
Step 7: Download and save the generated application acknowledgment PDF for certificate verification.
documentsRequired: SSC / 10th Class Marks Memo (Proof of Date of Birth & Education).
Local Residence / Domicile Certificate issued by Tahsildar / MRO specifying the local village/ward.
Integrated Community / Caste Certificate (SC / ST / BC / EWS).
Marriage Proof / Ration Card / Aadhaar Card with Husband's name (Death Certificate of husband in case of widow / Divorce decree for divorced women).
Disability Certificate (SADAREM) for Visually Handicapped (VH) / Hearing Handicapped (HH) categories.
Recent Passport-size Photograph and Signature.
Aadhaar Card copy.

overview: Bihar Combined Entrance Competitive Examination Board (BCECEB) on behalf of Bihar State Food & Civil Supplies Corporation Limited (BSFC), under the Department of Food & Consumer Protection, Government of Bihar, has officially released detailed recruitment advertisement No. BCECEB(BSFC)-2026/01 dated 24.08.2026 for filling up 259 regular vacancies across 5 major non-gazetted and executive cadres on regular basis.

The 259 total vacancies are allocated as follows: 81 posts of Assistant Manager (सहायक प्रबंधक) in Pay Level-7 (GP ₹4600), 06 posts of Assistant Accounts Officer (सहायक लेखा पदाधिकारी) in Pay Level-7 (GP ₹4600), 11 posts of Accountant (लेखापाल) in Pay Level-4 (GP ₹2400), 38 posts of Quality Controller (गुणवत्ता नियंत्रक) in Pay Level-4 (GP ₹2400), and 123 posts of Lower Division Clerk / Lower Grade Clerk (निम्नवर्गीय लिपिक - LDC) in Pay Level-2 (GP ₹1900).

Online registration and application submission begins on 25 August 2026 and closes on 24 September 2026 (11:59 PM). The Computer Based Test (CBT) will comprise 100 objective multiple-choice questions (100 marks) of 2 hours and 15 minutes duration with no negative marking. For the LDC post, a computer typing proficiency test (Hindi @ 30 wpm / English @ 35 wpm) is qualifying in nature.

reservation.title: State Reservation Policy & Horizontal Quotas
detailsList: Vertical Reservation: Scheduled Caste (SC): 16%, Scheduled Tribe (ST): 1%, Extremely Backward Class (EBC): 18%, Backward Class (BC): 12%, Economically Weaker Sections (EWS): 10%, Backward Classes Women (WBC): 3%.
Horizontal Reservation for Women (35%): 35% horizontal reservation is provided across all categories for women of Bihar domicile.

Horizontal Reservation for Divyangjan (4% / 8 Posts): VI (Visual Impairment): 2 Posts, DD (Deaf & Hard of Hearing): 1 Post, OH (Locomotor Disability): 3 Posts, MM (Mental / Multiple Disabilities): 2 Posts.
Horizontal Reservation for Freedom Fighters (2% / 5 Posts): 2% reservation for grandchildren (पोता/पोती/नाती/नातिनी) of freedom fighters of Bihar.
Domicile Requirement: All reservation benefits (age relaxation, fee concession, vertical & horizontal seat reservation) are admissible strictly to permanent residents of Bihar.

howToApply: Step 1 (Registration): Visit the official BCECEB portal at https://bceceboard.bihar.gov.in and click on 'Online Portal of Food & Civil Supplies Corporation Ltd.'.
Step 2: Click on 'Apply Online' -> 'Click here for Registration'. Enter your basic details, active email ID, and mobile number to receive your Registration Number and Password.
Step 3 (Basic Details): Log in using Registration Number and Password, enter personal information, category, domicile, and change your password upon initial login.
Step 4 (Educational Qualification Details): Fill in complete academic details from Matriculation, 10+2, Graduation, Post Graduation / MBA / B.Com / B.Sc / B.Tech / CA details.
Step 5 (Experience Details): Enter relevant work experience details (mandatory for AAO non-CA route, optional for others) and click Save & Next.
Step 6 (Upload Photo & Signature): Upload high-contrast passport-size colored photograph and clear scanned signatures in both Hindi and English.
Step 7 (Preview & Verification): Preview the complete application form, verify all entries, check the declaration box, and click 'Final Submit'.

Step 8 (Fee Payment & Download Receipt): Pay the application fee (₹1,200/- for UR/EWS/BC/EBC or ₹600/- for SC/ST/PwBD) via Debit Card, Credit Card, UPI, or Net Banking, then download and print the final Application Form (Part-A & Part-B) and Transaction Receipt.

faqs.answer: The Bihar Combined Entrance Competitive Examination Board (BCECEB) is conducting the recruitment on behalf of Bihar State Food & Civil Supplies Corporation Ltd. (BSFC) under the Food & Consumer Protection Department, Govt of Bihar (Advt No. BCECEB(BSFC)-2026/01).

faqs.answer: Online applications start on 25 August 2026 and the last date to register is 24 September 2026. The fee payment deadline is 25 September 2026.

faqs.question: What is the educational qualification required for Lower Division Clerk (LDC) in BSFC?

karnataka-examinations-authori-residenti.title: KEA Karnataka Residential School Teacher Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online for 140 Posts (Social Welfare Dept, RPC & KK Cadres)
overview: Karnataka Examinations Authority (KEA), Bengaluru, on behalf of the Department of Social Welfare, Government of Karnataka (ಸಮಾಜ ಕಲ್ಯಾಣ ಇಲಾಖೆ), has officially published two recruitment notifications (No. ED/KEA/38/RECT/2026(RPC) & No. ED/KEA/39/RECT/2026(KK) dated 20.08.2026) for the direct recruitment of 140 Residential School Teachers (ವಸತಿ ಶಾಲಾ ಶಿಕ್ಷಕರು - Vasathi Shala Shikshakaru) through a competitive examination.

The total 140 vacancies are bifurcated into: Residual Post Cadre / RPC (ಉಳಿಕೆ ಮೂಲ ವೃಂದ - 100 Posts under Advt No. 38) and Kalyana Karnataka Cadre / KK (ಕಲ್ಯಾಣ ಕರ್ನಾಟಕ ವೃಂದ - 40 Posts under Advt No. 39 under Article 371-J).

Candidates who have passed PUC (10+2 / Class 12) with at least 50% marks (45% for SC/ST/Cat-1/PwD) and hold a 2-year Diploma in Elementary Education (D.El.Ed), 4-year Bachelor in Elementary Education (B.El.Ed), or 2-year Diploma in Education (Special Education), along with a valid qualification in the Teacher Eligibility Test (KARTET / CTET), are eligible to apply.

Selected candidates will be appointed on a 2-year probation period in residential schools across Karnataka, drawing a monthly salary under the 2024 Revised Karnataka State Pay Scale of ₹41,300 - ₹81,800 plus Dearness Allowance, HRA, and NPS pension benefits. Online applications are accepted on the official KEA portal (https://cetonline.karnataka.gov.in/kea/) from 21 August 2026 to 18 September 2026 (Fee payment till 19 September 2026).

Appointments will be conducted under the Bihar Medical Education Service Cadre (Recruitment, Appointment, and Promotion) Rules 2008, Amendment Rules 2013, and Amendment Rules 2026. The selection adheres to the National Medical Commission (NMC Teachers Eligibility Qualifications in Medical Institutions Regulations, 2025) and DCI standards for MD, MS, DNB, and MDS degree holders.

Vacancies are distributed as 40% for Bihar State Health Services cadre doctors, 40% for candidates completing PG Degree under Residency Scheme from Bihar Govt Medical/Dental Colleges, and 20% for candidates completing PG Degree from other recognized institutions outside Bihar. Eligible candidates can apply online at bceceboard.bihar.gov.in between 25 August 2026 and 08 September 2026 (10:00 PM).

selectionProcess: Online Application Submission and Fee Payment through BCECEB Portal.
Scrutiny of educational eligibility according to NMC Teachers Eligibility Regulations 2025 and DCI norms.
Preparation of category-wise and specialty-wise merit panel following 40:40:20 quota allocations (40% BSHS, 40% Bihar Govt Medical Colleges, 20% Outside Institutions).
Document Verification of original academic degrees, MCI/NMC/DCI registrations, caste/domicile certificates, and two copies of downloaded Verification Slip (जाँच-पर्ची).
Final allotment and issuance of 3-year tenure appointment orders by Health Department, Govt. of Bihar.
howToApplySteps: Visit BCECEB official website at https://bceceboard.bihar.gov.in.
Click on the link Online Portal of Senior Resident / Tutor under Health Dept. and select Apply for Senior Resident / Tutor.
Step 1 (Registration): Enter candidate name, active mobile number, and email ID. Verify mobile and email via separate OTP verification codes.

Step 2 (Multi-Step Application): (a) Select Department/Specialty; (b) Enter Personal Information; (c) Enter Permanent and Correspondence Address; (d) Enter Educational Qualifications (MBBS/BDS & MD/MS/DNB/MDS/Diploma); (e) Upload high-contrast photograph, signature, and capture live photograph.
Step 3 (Preview and Final Submit): Thoroughly verify all entered data. Click Final Submit and Proceed to Payment.
Step 4 (Payment of Counselling Fee): Pay Rs. 2,250/- online via Debit Card, Credit Card, Net Banking, or UPI on or before 08.09.2026 (11:59 PM).
Step 5 (Download Confirmation Page): Download and print the Confirmation Page and Fee Receipt for future reference and Document Verification (Hard copy does NOT need to be sent by post to the Board).
