Transgender Identity Certificate issued by District Magistrate under Form-3 (if applicable).
Valid Photo Identity Proof (Aadhaar Card, Voter ID, PAN Card).
Scanned copies of recent passport-size color photograph and signatures in Hindi and English.
importantInstructions: Only enrolled and trained personnel of Bihar Home Guard (बिहार गृह रक्षा वाहिनी) with minimum 5 years duty experience and minimum 10 years remaining service are eligible.
Married female candidates claiming reservation must submit Caste/NCL certificates issued in the name and address of their father, not husband.
A uniform non-refundable fee of Rs. 100/- applies to all categories. Chargeback claims after submission will lead to cancellation of candidature and legal action.
A candidate can submit only ONE application form using a single mobile number and email ID. Multiple applications will lead to rejection of all submissions.
No physical copies of the application form need to be sent to BPSSC, but candidates must retain the printed acknowledgement slip for document verification.
Negative marking of 0.2 marks applies for each wrong answer in both Preliminary and Main Written Examinations.

faqs.question: How many vacancies are released under BPSSC Advt 11/2026?
faqs.answer: A total of 65 vacancies are officially released for the post of Gulma Samadesta / Company Commander (गुल्म समादेशक) under the Bihar Home Guard Service Cadre, including 22 horizontal quota posts for domicile women.

faqs.question: Who is eligible to apply for Company Commander under Advt 11/2026?
faqs.answer: Enrolled and trained Home Guards of Bihar Home Guard Organization who have completed at least 5 years of duty as of 01.08.2026, possess a Bachelor's Degree (Graduation), and have at least 10 years of remaining service are eligible.

faqs.question: What is the pay scale for BPSSC Company Commander?
faqs.answer: The post carries Pay Level-6 in the 7th CPC Pay Matrix, with starting basic pay of Rs. 35,400/- per month plus admissible state DA, HRA, and medical allowances.

faqs.question: What is the age limit for BPSSC Company Commander recruitment?
faqs.answer: The age limit is 24 to 50 years as on the cut-off date of 01 August 2026 for all categories of candidates based on Matriculation certificate.

faqs.question: What is the online application start and last date?
faqs.answer: Online application registration starts on 10 September 2026 and closes on 10 October 2026 on the BPSSC official website.

faqs.question: What is the application fee for BPSSC Advt 11/2026?
faqs.answer: The application fee is Rs. 100/- for all categories of candidates (Male, Female, Transgender / General, EWS, BC, EBC, SC, ST).

faqs.question: What is the selection process for Company Commander in Bihar Home Guard?
faqs.answer: Selection includes: (1) Preliminary Written Exam (200 marks, GK & Current Affairs), (2) Main Written Exam (Paper 1 Hindi 200 marks qualifying + Paper 2 General Studies 200 marks), (3) Physical Efficiency Test (PET), (4) Physical Standard Test (PST), and (5) Medical & Antecedent Verification.

faqs.question: Is there negative marking in BPSSC Company Commander exam?
faqs.answer: Yes, 0.2 marks will be deducted for each incorrect answer in both Preliminary and Main Written Examinations.

faqs.question: How is the final merit list prepared for Company Commander?
faqs.answer: The final merit list is prepared strictly based on the marks scored in Paper-2 (General Studies - 200 marks) of the Main Examination among candidates qualifying the PET and PST.

faqs.question: What are the physical standards (Height & Chest) required for male candidates?
faqs.answer: Height: Minimum 165 cm for General/BC males; Minimum 160 cm for EBC/SC/ST males. Chest: 81-86 cm for General/BC/EBC males; 79-84 cm for SC/ST males (min 5 cm expansion).

faqs.question: What are the physical standards for female candidates?
faqs.answer: Female candidates of all categories must have a minimum height of 155 cm and a minimum weight of 48 kg. There is no chest measurement for women.

faqs.question: What are the PET running criteria for male and female applicants?
faqs.answer: Male candidates must complete a 1.6 km (1 mile) run within 6 minutes 30 seconds. Female candidates must complete a 1.0 km run within 6 minutes.

faqs.question: Can direct civilian graduates apply for this vacancy?
faqs.answer: No. As per Advt. No. 11/2026, the post of Gulma Samadesta is reserved specifically for enrolled and trained members of the Bihar Home Guard Organization who have completed at least 5 years of duty.

faqs.question: What documents are needed for caste and reservation claims for married women?
faqs.answer: Married female candidates must submit Caste and Non-Creamy Layer (NCL) certificates issued on the basis of their father's name and permanent residence, not their husband's.

faqs.question: Where can I apply online for BPSSC Advt 11/2026?
faqs.answer: Candidates can apply online directly through the official BPSSC portal at https://bpssc.bihar.gov.in under the 'Home Guard' tab starting 10 September 2026.

gsrtc-helper-helper-recruitment-2026.title: GSRTC Recruitment 2026 Notification Out for 2510 Helper Posts | Apply Online at ojas.gujarat.gov.in
overview: Gujarat State Road Transport Corporation (GSRTC), Central Office, Ranip, Ahmedabad has officially published a massive employment notification (Advt. No. GSRTC/202627/47) for the direct recruitment of 2,510 Helper (હેલ્પર) positions. The recruitment is open for candidates possessing ITI trade certifications in designated mechanical, automotive, and electrical trades. Selected candidates will be appointed on a 5-year contractual basis with a fixed monthly remuneration of ₹21,100/-, after which they will be absorbed into regular pay scales upon satisfactory service.

The 2,510 vacancies are distributed across Unreserved/General (1,003 posts), SEBC/OBC (659 posts), ST (417 posts), EWS (261 posts), and SC (170 posts), with substantial horizontal reservations of 502 posts for Ex-Servicemen and 52 posts for Persons with Benchmark Disabilities (PwD/Divyang). Applicants must be between 18 and 35 years of age as on the closing date, with statutory upper age relaxations up to 45 years applicable for reserved categories, women, and PwD candidates.

The selection will be finalized through a comprehensive merit scheme consisting of a 100-mark OMR/CBRT Objective Examination (carrying 90% weightage) and NCVT Trade Apprenticeship Certificate (carrying 10% weightage), followed by document verification of 1.5 times the shortlisted candidates. education: Minimum Educational Qualification: Must have passed at least a 1-year course from a Government-recognized Industrial Training Institute (ITI) in any of the following 13 trades:
1. Mechanic Motor Vehicle (MMV)
2. Mechanic Diesel
3. General Mechanic
4. Fitter
5. Turner
6. Electrician
7. Sheet Metal Worker
8. Auto Mobile Body Repairer
9. Welder or Welder cum Fabricator
10. Machinist
11. Carpenter
12. Painter General
13. Auto Mobile Paint Repairer

Preferential / Additional Qualification: Candidates who have completed Apprenticeship in the same trade from a Government / Semi-Government / Public Sector Undertaking (PSU) / Limited or Private Limited Company and possess the National Council for Vocational Training (NCVT) certificate and marksheet will receive 10 marks weightage in final merit.

Computer Literacy: Must possess basic computer knowledge certificate in accordance with Gujarat Government GAD Resolution No. CRR-10-2007-120320-G.5 dated 13/08/2008 (CCC certificate from recognized training institute, or Diploma/Degree with computer subject, or Class 10th/12th passed with computer subject).
Medical & Physical Standards: Clear vision is mandatory (ચોખ્ખું વિઝન હોવું જોઈએ) with sound physical and mental health suitable for heavy automotive repair, maintenance, and workshop helper duties.
eligibility.ageLimit: 18 to 35 years as on 06 October 2026 (Born between 06/10/1991 and 06/10/2008 inclusive).
ageRelaxation: General (Unreserved) Female Candidates: 5 Years relaxation (Up to 40 Years)
Reserved Male Candidates (SEBC, EWS, SC, ST): 5 Years relaxation (Up to 40 Years)
Reserved Female Candidates (SEBC, EWS, SC, ST): 10 Years relaxation (Up to 45 Years)
General PwD (Divyang) Male Candidates: 10 Years relaxation (Up to 45 Years)
General PwD (Divyang) Female Candidates: 15 Years relaxation (Up to 45 Years)
Reserved PwD (Divyang) Male Candidates: 15 Years relaxation (Up to 45 Years)
Reserved PwD (Divyang) Female Candidates: 20 Years relaxation (Capped at 45 Years)
Ex-Servicemen: Total military service rendered plus 3 years (Up to 45 Years)
Maximum Age Cap: Under no circumstances shall the maximum age with all relaxations exceed 45 years as on the closing date.
eligibility.medicalStandards: Must possess clear eyesight (ચોખ્ખું વિઝન) and sound physical health suitable for workshop/depot operations. PwD candidates with benchmark disabilities (minimum 40%) must produce valid medical certificates issued by Civil Surgeon/Medical Board.

After satisfactory completion of 5 years of service, candidates will be absorbed into regular permanent appointment in the prevailing Helper cadre pay scale of GSRTC with standard allowances (DA, HRA, Provident Fund, Medical, Gratuity).

howToPayFee: Candidates must submit the non-refundable online examination process fee on the OJAS portal (https://ojas.gujarat.gov.in) via the Online Payment Gateway using Net Banking, Debit Card, Credit Card, or UPI.
The fee payment portal remains active from 07 September 2026 to 08 October 2026 (up to 23:59 hrs). After payment, save and print the online e-receipt.

selectionProcess.description: Objective Multiple Choice Question (MCQ) exam consisting of 100 questions for 100 marks with a duration of 2 hours (120 minutes). Carries 90% weightage (maximum 90 marks) towards the final merit.

Candidates who completed an NCVT Trade Apprenticeship in the same trade from Govt/Semi-Govt/PSU/Reputed Company receive 10% weightage (maximum 10 marks). Candidates without apprenticeship receive 0 marks in this component.

Candidates shortlisted at a ratio of 1:1.5 times the category-wise vacancies based on combined merit (Written Exam 90% + Apprenticeship 10%) will be called for scrutiny of original certificates, ITI marksheets, NCVT certificate, caste certificates, and identity proof.

Provisional merit list and a 20% waiting list (valid for 2 years or until next recruitment) will be published. Selected candidates will be allotted divisions/depots across Gujarat according to Corporation requirements.

howToApply: Visit the official OJAS Gujarat recruitment portal at https://ojas.gujarat.gov.in.
Click on 'Apply Online' on the homepage and select the Helper Cadre ('હેલ્પર કક્ષા') under GSRTC recruitment.
Click on 'Apply Now' to open the online application form and fill in Personal Details accurately (fields marked with red asterisk are mandatory).
Under 'Educational Qualification', select Minimum Qualification and enter your ITI Trade details, Institute, Year of Passing, and percentage.
Under 'Additional Educational Qualification', enter your NCVT Trade Apprenticeship details (if completed in the same trade).
Under 'Computer Knowledge', enter your basic computer qualification details in accordance with Government guidelines.
Read the self-declaration carefully, check 'Yes' to accept terms, and click 'Save' to generate your unique Application Number.
Click 'Upload Photograph' and 'Upload Signature' to upload scanned JPG images (under 10 KB each; Photo: 5 cm x 3.6 cm; Signature: 2.5 cm x 7.5 cm).
Click 'Confirm Application', enter your Application Number and Date of Birth, verify preview details, and click 'Confirm' to generate your permanent 'Confirmation Number'.

Click on 'Online Payment of Fees', enter your Confirmation Number and Date of Birth, and pay the examination process fee (₹300+GST for General; ₹200+GST for Reserved/Women/PwD/Ex-SM) via the payment gateway.
After successful payment, print and retain a copy of the confirmed Application Form and Fee Receipt for document verification.
documentsRequired: Printed copy of Confirmed Online Application Form with Confirmation Number
Original ITI Marksheets and National Trade Certificate (NTC) in the applied trade
NCVT Trade Apprenticeship Certificate and Marksheet (for 10 marks weightage, if applicable)
SSC / Class 10th Marksheet and School Leaving Certificate (for Date of Birth proof)
Basic Computer Knowledge Certificate (CCC / Diploma / Degree / 10th or 12th with computer subject)
Caste / Category Certificate for SC / ST / SEBC / EWS candidates issued by competent authority
Non-Creamy Layer (NCL) Certificate (Parishisht-4 / Annexure-A) for SEBC candidates (for married women, based on parents' income)
Income and Asset Certificate for EWS candidates (Annexure-KH / Parishisht-G)
Valid Disability Certificate issued by Civil Surgeon / Medical Board (for PwD candidates, min 40%)
Discharge Book, Identity Card, and Service Certificate (for Ex-Servicemen)
Sports Representation Certificate in prescribed format from competent sports authority (if claiming sports weightage)
No Objection Certificate (NOC) from present employer for Govt / Semi-Govt / Board employees
Valid Photo Identity Card (Aadhaar Card, Voter ID, Driving Licence, or PAN Card) and 2 passport-size photographs
importantInstructions: Application Mode: Only online applications submitted via https://ojas.gujarat.gov.in will be accepted. Offline or physical applications will be rejected.

Multiple Applications: If a candidate submits more than one application, only the last confirmed application with deposited fees will be considered valid; earlier forms will be automatically cancelled.
Mobile & Email: The registered mobile number and email ID must be kept active until the recruitment process concludes, as all updates and SMS alerts will be sent there.

Apprenticeship Trade Alignment: The NCVT Apprenticeship certificate will only yield 10 marks weightage if completed strictly in the same ITI trade as the applicant's basic qualification (e.g. Electrician ITI with Electrician Apprenticeship).
Posting: Appointed candidates can be deployed to any division, depot, or central workshop of GSRTC across Gujarat depending on administrative requirements.

faqs.question: What is the total number of Helper vacancies advertised by GSRTC?
faqs.answer: GSRTC has released 2,510 vacancies for the post of Helper under Advertisement No. GSRTC/202627/47.

faqs.question: What is the monthly salary for GSRTC Helper during the contract period?
faqs.answer: Selected candidates will receive a fixed monthly salary of ₹21,100/- for 5 years on a contractual basis, after which they will be eligible for regular appointment in the Helper cadre.

faqs.question: What is the required educational qualification for GSRTC Helper?
faqs.answer: Candidates must have passed at least a 1-year course from a Government-recognized ITI in Motor Mechanic, Mechanic Diesel, Fitter, Turner, Electrician, Welder, Machinist, Carpenter, Painter, Sheet Metal Worker, or Auto Mobile Paint/Body Repairer.

faqs.question: How is the 10 marks weightage for Apprenticeship awarded?
faqs.answer: Candidates who completed an NCVT Trade Apprenticeship in the same ITI trade from a Government, Semi-Government, PSU, or registered Limited/Pvt Ltd company receive 10 marks weightage. Those without apprenticeship receive 0 out of 10.

faqs.question: What is the selection process and marks distribution for GSRTC Helper?
faqs.answer: The selection scheme has a total weightage of 100 marks: 90 marks (90% weightage) from a 100-mark MCQ written exam (OMR or CBRT) and 10 marks (10% weightage) from the NCVT Apprenticeship certificate. Merit candidates at a 1:1.5 ratio are called for document verification.

faqs.question: What is the exam syllabus and pattern for the written test?
faqs.answer: The 2-hour written test has 100 MCQs (100 Marks): Gujarat GK, History, Geography & Current Affairs (30 Marks), Gujarati Grammar (5 Marks), English Grammar (5 Marks), Trade/Technical Subject Questions (50 Marks), and Basic Computer Knowledge (10 Marks).

faqs.question: What are the start and closing dates for online applications?
faqs.answer: Online applications on OJAS Gujarat opened on 07 September 2026 and will close on 06 October 2026 (23:59 hrs). The examination process fee can be paid until 08 October 2026 (23:59 hrs).

faqs.question: What is the application fee for GSRTC Helper recruitment?
faqs.answer: General (Unreserved) candidates must pay ₹300/- + GST. Reserved category candidates (All Female applicants, SEBC, SC, ST, EWS, PwD, and Ex-Servicemen) must pay ₹200/- + GST.

faqs.question: What is the age limit and crucial date for calculating age?
faqs.answer: Candidates must be aged between 18 and 35 years as on 06 October 2026 (Born between 06/10/1991 and 06/10/2008). Upper age relaxation of 5 to 20 years applies to reserved categories, women, and PwD candidates, subject to a maximum age cap of 45 years.

faqs.question: Is computer knowledge compulsory for applying to GSRTC Helper?
faqs.answer: Yes. Candidates must possess basic computer knowledge certification (CCC or equivalent) as per Gujarat Government General Administration Department resolution dated 13/08/2008.

faqs.question: What are the specifications for uploading photograph and signature on OJAS?
faqs.answer: Photograph and signature must be in JPG format and not exceed 10 KB each. Photograph size should be 5 cm height x 3.6 cm width, and Signature size should be 2.5 cm height x 7.5 cm width.

faqs.question: What are the rules for SEBC Non-Creamy Layer (NCL) Certificate?
faqs.answer: SEBC candidates must produce a Non-Creamy Layer Certificate (Parishisht-4 in Gujarati or Annexure-A in English) for financial years 2023-24, 2024-25, and 2025-26, issued between 01/04/2024 and 06/10/2026. For married female candidates, it must be based on parents' income.

faqs.question: What are the rules for EWS Income and Asset Certificate?
faqs.answer: EWS candidates must possess a certificate (Annexure-KH or Parishisht-G) issued between 07/10/2023 and 06/10/2026, or an Income & Asset Certificate for FY 2025-26 issued between 01/04/2026 and 06/10/2026.

faqs.question: Where will the selected candidates be posted?
faqs.answer: Selected candidates can be posted to any division, depot, or central workshop across Gujarat according to operational requirements of the Gujarat State Road Transport Corporation.

faqs.question: Where can candidates download the official notification and apply?
faqs.answer: Candidates can download the official notification and apply online on the OJAS Gujarat portal at https://ojas.gujarat.gov.in and check regular updates on https://gsrtc.in.

syllabus.Basic Computer Knowledge: Fundamental computer concepts, Windows OS, MS Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint), Web Browsing, Email, Internet Banking, File Management, and Keyboard Shortcuts.

overview: The Directorate of Tourism, Government of Kerala, in coordination with the Centre for Management Development (CMD), Thiruvananthapuram, has issued official recruitment notification No. CMD/DoT/01/2026 (dated 05 September 2026) for the engagement of 162 Green Marshals on a daily wage basis for a period of one year. Green Marshals will be deployed across designated tourist destinations and eco-tourism sites throughout all 14 districts of Kerala to enforce sustainable tourism practices and the state's Green Protocol in coordination with District Tourism Promotion Councils (DTPCs).

Candidates possessing a minimum educational qualification of SSLC (Class 10th Pass) and aged between 20 and 45 years as on 01 September 2026 are eligible to apply. Selected personnel will receive remuneration of ₹810/- per day based on actual attendance and engagement days. Applicants must select one district of preference, and local residents of the respective district will receive tie-breaking preference in the selection merit list.

Shortlisting will be conducted district-wise strictly on the basis of percentage of marks secured in the SSLC qualifying examination, followed by an interview and proficiency assessment conducted by the Directorate of Tourism. Eligible candidates must submit their applications online through the official CMD Kerala portal (www.cmd.kerala.gov.in) from 05 September 2026 (10:00 AM) to 11 September 2026 (05:00 PM). There is no application fee.

education: Minimum Educational Qualification: Passed Secondary School Leaving Certificate (SSLC) / Class 10th or equivalent qualifying examination from a recognized Board.
Merit percentage calculation: Percentage = (Marks Obtained ÷ Maximum Marks) × 100. System-calculated from marks entered and verified against original documents.

Preference for Local Residents: Candidates must indicate only ONE district of preference. Preference for local residents of the district will be applied as a tie-breaker among candidates securing the same SSLC percentage (subject to valid residence proof).
Age tie-breaker: Where SSLC percentages are equal and local preference does not resolve the tie, the older candidate will rank higher based on Date of Birth.

Medical & Physical Fitness: Candidates must be physically fit to perform outdoor field duties associated with Green Marshal (monitoring waste disposal, enforcing green protocol, public assistance at tourist destinations). A medical fitness certificate may be required before engagement.

faqs.answer: Shortlisting is done district-wise based on the percentage of marks obtained in SSLC. Preference for local residents serves as the tie-breaker for identical marks, followed by age (older candidate ranks higher).

faqs.question: Will there be an interview for Green Marshal?
faqs.answer: Yes, shortlisted candidates will be evaluated through an interview/proficiency assessment conducted by the Directorate of Tourism.

faqs.question: What is the duration and nature of the Green Marshal engagement?
faqs.answer: The engagement is purely temporary on a daily wage basis for a period of one year. It confers no right to regularization or absorption.

faqs.question: Which district has the highest number of vacancies?
faqs.answer: Ernakulam has the highest vacancies (21), followed by Thiruvananthapuram (19), Thrissur (18), Wayanad (16), Kollam (14), and Idukki (14).

faqs.question: What are the core duties of a Green Marshal?
faqs.answer: Green Marshals are deployed at key tourist destinations to implement the Green Protocol, maintain environmental cleanliness, discourage single-use plastics, and guide visitors.

faqs.question: Can selected candidates be deployed outside their chosen district?
faqs.answer: Yes. While initial deployment is within the chosen district, the Directorate of Tourism/CMD reserves the right to deploy or redeploy candidates to any tourism destination across Kerala based on demand.

faqs.question: Where can candidates apply online?
faqs.answer: Eligible candidates can apply online through the Centre for Management Development (CMD) website at https://www.cmd.kerala.gov.in.

faqs.question: What documents are required for the application and verification?
faqs.answer: Candidates need an SSLC marksheet/certificate, proof of date of birth, residence/nativity certificate for local tie-break preference, valid photo ID, and passport-size photographs.

overview: Maharashtra Metro Rail Corporation Limited (MAHA-Metro), a premier 50:50 Joint Venture Company of the Government of India and the Government of Maharashtra implementing prestigious metro projects including Nagpur Metro, Pune Metro, Thane Integral Ring Metro, and O&M of Navi Mumbai Metro Line-1, has officially released recruitment advertisement MAHA-Metro/N/HR/05/2026 (dated 10 August 2026). The notification invites offline applications from experienced personnel of Indian nationality holding Maharashtra domicile for 56 supervisory and non-supervisory positions on a 3-year contract basis.

The recruitment drive comprises 40 vacancies for the Nagpur Metro Rail Project and 16 vacancies for the Pune Metro Rail Project. Positions include Junior Engineer (Civil, Electrical, Rolling Stock, S&T) in IDA Pay Scale Rs. 33,000-1,00,000/-, Senior Office Assistant (PR/Library) in Rs. 33,000-1,00,000/-, Office Assistant in Rs. 25,000-80,000/-, Technicians (Civil, Electrical, Diesel Mechanic, Electronic Mechanic) in Rs. 20,000-60,000/-, Multi Tasking Staff cum Motor Driver in Rs. 16,000-50,000/-, and Attendant in Rs. 14,000-40,000/-. Applicants must possess required engineering degrees, diplomas, ITI certificates, or graduate/school credentials along with 3 to 5 years of relevant post-qualification experience in Metro Rail, Railways, PSUs, or allied infrastructure industries.

Candidates meeting the eligibility criteria must submit their physical application in the prescribed format (Annexure-I) along with supporting documents, experience proforma (Annexure-II), and application fee (Demand Draft or UPI/BHIM receipt) via Speed Post to the General Manager (HR), Maharashtra Metro Rail Corporation Ltd., Metro Bhawan, Nagpur - 440010. Applications must reach on or before 25 September 2026 by 18:00 hrs. The selection process involves a 70-mark Written Test (Online/Offline), a 30-mark Personal Interview (or Oral Aptitude Test for MTS/Attendants), and Pre-Employment Medical Examination.

overview: Central University of Punjab (CUPB), Bathinda (a premier Central University established by an Act of Parliament) has officially issued employment notification Advt. No. CUPB/26-27/012 (dated 02 September 2026) for filling 15 Teaching and Non-Teaching positions purely on temporary and contractual basis. The positions include 1 Contractual Faculty (Self-Finance) in B.Tech Computer Science & Engineering, 8 Part-Time Faculty positions on lecture basis across Music, Law, Physics, Mathematics, Chemistry, Zoology, Botany, and Economics for ITEP B.Sc.-B.Ed. / B.A.-B.Ed., and 6 Contractual Non-Teaching positions (Senior Analyst, Laboratory Assistant, and Laboratory Attendant).

Selected candidates for teaching posts will receive attractive consolidated emoluments up to Rs. 64,000/- per month (or Rs. 1,000/- per lecture up to Rs. 50,000/- per month for part-time faculty). Non-teaching personnel will receive fixed monthly emoluments of Rs. 65,000/- (Senior Analyst), Rs. 40,800/- (Laboratory Assistant), and Rs. 28,800/- (Laboratory Attendant). Candidates must possess requisite Master's/Ph.D./NET or B.Tech/Diploma/Degree/10+2 Science qualifications with relevant laboratory or teaching experience.

Candidates must register online on the respective Samarth portals (https://cuprec.samarth.edu.in for Faculty and https://cupnt.samarth.edu.in for Non-Teaching) before the deadline mentioned for each post (09 to 15 September 2026, 10:00 AM). Applicants must attend the Walk-in Interview at the Main Campus, VPO Ghudda, Bathinda with printed online application forms, original documents, experience certificates, and a 10-minute presentation (for faculty positions).

overview: United India Insurance Company Limited (UIIC), a premier wholly-owned Government of India Public Sector General Insurance Company headquartered in Chennai, has officially announced employment notification Ref: HO:HRM:REC:AO:1:2026 (dated 07 September 2026) for open market recruitment of 225 Administrative Officers (Scale-I) in Generalists and Hindi Officer disciplines.

The total 225 vacancies comprise 200 Administrative Officer (Generalists) posts and 25 Administrative Officer (Hindi Officer) posts, with category-wise reservations across UR (79), OBC (69), SC (34), EWS (24), and ST (19), along with 4% horizontal reservation for Persons with Benchmark Disabilities (PwBD). Selected officers will be placed on the revised pay scale of ₹82,485 - ₹1,56,745 with approximate gross monthly emoluments of ₹1,10,000/- at metropolitan centers, in addition to benefits including leased accommodation, National Pension System (NPS), Gratuity, Medical, and Group Insurance.

Candidates possessing a Bachelor's or Master's Degree with minimum 60% marks (55% for SC/ST/PwBD) and aged between 21 and 30 years as on 30.06.2026 are eligible to apply. Selection will be finalized through a competitive multi-tier process comprising a Preliminary Examination (Tier-I), Main Examination with Descriptive Test (Tier-II), and Personal Interview. Online registration is open on the official website (https://uiic.co.in) from 08 September 2026 to 28 September 2026.

For Generalists: Objective Test (200 Qs / 250 Marks / 150 mins) + Descriptive English Test (2 Qs / 30 Marks / 30 mins). For Hindi Officers: Objective Test (150 Qs / 200 Marks / 120 mins) + Descriptive English & Hindi Test (5 Qs / 50 Marks / 60 mins). Penalty of 0.25 marks for wrong answers in objective sections.
Candidates qualifying Tier-II will be called for interview at select centers in a ratio up to 3 times the vacancies. Outstation candidates will be reimbursed Sleeper Class rail/bus fare.

Final selection is framed on combined merit of Tier-II Main Objective Test and Interview in the ratio of 75:25 (Tier-I Prelims marks are not counted). For Hindi Officers, both Objective and Descriptive marks are included with interview in 75:25 ratio.

Appointed officers undergo 1-year probation during which they must pass the Licentiate Examination of Insurance Institute of India. Selected candidates execute a 5-year Guarantee Bond (liquidated damages up to 1-year gross pay + ₹35,000/- onboarding cost).

faqs.question: What is the total number of vacancies in UIIC AO Recruitment 2026?
faqs.answer: A total of 225 vacancies are announced: 200 posts for Administrative Officer (Generalists) and 25 posts for Administrative Officer (Hindi Officers).

faqs.question: What is the starting salary and gross emoluments for UIIC AO Scale-I?
faqs.answer: The basic pay starts at ₹82,485/- on the scale of ₹82,485 - ₹1,56,745. Total gross monthly emoluments are approximately ₹1,10,000/- per month at metropolitan centers, plus leased accommodation, medical, NPS, and other allowances.

faqs.question: What is the educational qualification for UIIC AO Generalists?
faqs.answer: A Graduate or Post Graduate degree in any discipline (Arts, Science, Commerce, Engineering, Agriculture, Data Science, etc.) with at least 60% marks (55% for SC/ST/PwBD) from a recognized university, along with computer working knowledge.

faqs.question: What is the educational qualification for UIIC AO Hindi Officers?
faqs.answer: Master's Degree in Hindi with English at bachelor's degree level (min 60% marks, 55% for SC/ST/PwBD) or Master's in English with Hindi at degree level, or Master's in any discipline with Hindi medium and English as a subject.

faqs.question: What is the age limit and crucial date for UIIC AO 2026?
faqs.answer: Candidates must be between 21 and 30 years old as on 30.06.2026 (born between 30.06.1996 and 30.06.2005). Upper age relaxations: 5 years for SC/ST, 3 years for OBC, 10 years for PwBD, and up to 45 years cumulative cap.

faqs.question: What are the important dates for online registration and examinations?
faqs.answer: Online registration runs from 08 September 2026 to 28 September 2026. Tentative exam dates: Tier-I Preliminary Exam on 22 October 2026 and Tier-II Main Exam on 30 November 2026.

faqs.question: What is the application fee for UIIC AO?
faqs.answer: General, OBC, and EWS candidates pay ₹1,000/- + applicable GST. SC, ST, PwBD, and UIIC permanent employees pay service charges of ₹250/- + applicable GST (application fee is Nil).

faqs.question: What is the exam pattern for Tier-I Preliminary Examination?
faqs.answer: Tier-I is an objective test of 100 marks (60 minutes, 20 mins per section): English Language (30 Qs / 30 Marks), Reasoning Ability (35 Qs / 35 Marks), and Quantitative Aptitude (35 Qs / 35 Marks). Qualifying in nature.

faqs.question: What is the structure of the Tier-II Main Examination?
faqs.answer: For Generalists: 200 objective questions for 250 marks (150 mins) covering English, Reasoning, Quant, Financial General Awareness, and Computers, plus an online descriptive test of 30 marks (Letter & Essay, 30 mins). For Hindi Officers: 150 objective questions for 200 marks plus 50 marks descriptive test.

faqs.question: How is the final merit list calculated for UIIC AO?
faqs.answer: Final selection merit is prepared based on marks obtained in Tier-II Main Examination and Personal Interview in the ratio of 75:25. Preliminary marks are not added.

faqs.question: Is there negative marking in the UIIC AO online tests?
faqs.answer: Yes. One-fourth (0.25) of the marks assigned to that question will be deducted as penalty for every wrong answer in both Preliminary and Main objective examinations.

faqs.question: What are the service bond and probation conditions?
faqs.answer: Appointed officers undergo 1-year probation (must pass Licentiate Exam of III) and sign a 5-year Guarantee Bond. Resigning before 5 years incurs liquidated damages up to 1-year gross salary plus ₹35,000/- onboarding cost.

faqs.question: Where will the selected candidates be posted?
faqs.answer: Vacancies are substantially in Western and Southern Zones. Candidates selected will likely be posted in Southern/Western offices for a minimum initial period of 5 years without transfer.

faqs.question: Can a candidate apply for both Generalist and Hindi Officer streams?
faqs.answer: No. A candidate can apply for either Generalists OR Hindi Officers, not both. Registering for both will result in automatic cancellation of all applications.

faqs.question: Where can candidates apply online for UIIC AO?
faqs.answer: Eligible candidates can register online through the recruitment section of the official website at https://uiic.co.in from 08 September 2026 to 28 September 2026.

overview: The Railway Recruitment Boards (RRBs), Ministry of Railways, Government of India, have officially released the Centralised Employment Notification (CEN) No. 05/2026 (Indicative Notice Ref No. RRB/RNC/Advt./CEN/05/2026 dated 12 September 2026) for the open-market recruitment to Various Posts of Paramedical Categories across Railway Recruitment Boards nationwide. An aggregate of 560 tentative vacancies has been notified under 7th CPC Pay Level 3 to Pay Level 7.

Eligible candidates are invited to submit their online applications strictly through ONLINE MODE ONLY on the official centralized recruitment portal (https://www.rrbapply.gov.in). The opening date for online application submission is tentatively scheduled for 15 September 2026, and the tentative closing date for application submission is 14 October 2026 (23:59 hrs). The crucial cut-off date for age limit calculation is 01 January 2027.

Important Candidate Directive on Aadhaar Verification: Candidates are strongly advised to verify their primary personal details using Aadhaar during online application form filling. The applicant's Name and Date of Birth in their Aadhaar card must match 100% with the Full Name and Date of Birth recorded in their Class 10th (Matriculation) pass certificate. Candidates must also ensure that their Aadhaar has been updated with their latest photograph and latest biometrics (Fingerprint and Iris) prior to filling the online application.

overview: The Arunachal Pradesh Public Service Commission (APPSC), Itanagar has officially issued Advertisement No. 5/2026 (Ref No. PSC-R/13/2026 dated 07 September 2026) inviting online applications from eligible citizens of India who are Permanent Residents of Arunachal Pradesh holding APST status for the Arunachal Pradesh Public Service Combined Competitive Examination-2026 (APPSCCE-2026). A total of 135 premier Group 'A' and Group 'B' vacancies have been announced across key administrative, police, developmental, and secretariat cadres of the Government of Arunachal Pradesh.

The advertised services comprise 60 posts of Arunachal Pradesh Civil Service (Entry Grade) APCS (EG) Group-A, 10 posts of Arunachal Pradesh Police Service (Entry Grade) APPS (EG) Group-A, 05 posts of Child Development Project Officer (CDPO), 04 posts of District Information & Public Relation Officer (DIPRO), 03 posts of District Food & Civil Supply Officer (DF&CSO), 01 post of District Transport Officer (DTO), 02 posts of Labour Officer, 05 posts of Station Superintendent / Assistant Station Superintendent, 06 posts of Tax/Excise/Commerce Inspectors, and 38 posts of Assistant Section Officer (ASO) in the Secretariat Administration Department. Selected officers will be placed under 7th CPC Pay Matrix Level-10 (₹56,100 - ₹1,77,500) for Group-A, Level-8/9 for Group-B Gazetted, and Level-7 (₹44,900 - ₹1,42,400) for Group-B Non-Gazetted.

Candidates possessing a Bachelor's Degree from a UGC-recognized University and aged between 21 and 35 years as on 20 October 2026 (with up to 40 years for APST) can submit their online applications via the APPSC portal (https://appsc.gov.in). Selection involves a 2-stage competitive examination: Preliminary Examination (Objective Type) scheduled for 06 December 2026 (Sunday), followed by Main Examination (Descriptive 8 Papers of 1750 Marks + Physical standards/PET for Police Service) and Viva-Voce / Personality Test (275 Marks).

overview: The Government of Telangana, through the District Welfare Officer (DWO), Women, Child, Disabled and Senior Citizens Welfare Department, Integrated Child Development Services (ICDS), Nagarkurnool District, has officially issued Employment Notification No. 185/A/DWO-NGKL/2026 (DIPR R.O. No. 9373-PP/CL/ADVT/2026-27 dated 03 September 2026) for the direct recruitment of 255 Anganwadi staff vacancies. The positions encompass 148 posts of Anganwadi Teacher (AWT) and 107 posts of Anganwadi Helper / Aayah (AWH) under ITDA & ST Sub-Plan areas across 5 key ICDS project jurisdictions in Nagarkurnool District.

The 255 vacancies are distributed across 5 ICDS project sectors: Achampet Project (77 vacancies: 36 AWT, 41 AWH), Balmoor Project (64 vacancies: 36 AWT, 28 AWH), Kalwakurthy Project (38 vacancies: 21 AWT, 17 AWH), Kollapur Project (34 vacancies: 22 AWT, 12 AWH), and Nagarkurnool Project (42 vacancies: 33 AWT, 9 AWH). Appointees receive monthly honorarium fixed by the Government of Telangana: ₹13,650/- per month for Anganwadi Teachers and ₹7,800/- per month for Anganwadi Helpers.

Applications are invited strictly from eligible local resident female candidates who have passed SSC (Class 10th) and are aged between 21 and 35 years as on 01 July 2026 (18 to 35 years for ST candidates in scheduled/ITDA agency areas). Online applications can be submitted through the official departmental recruitment portal (http://wdcw.tg.nic.in / https://mis.tgwdcw.in). The registration window opened on 07 September 2026 and will close on 21 September 2026 at 05:00 PM.

howToApply: Step 1: Visit the official Women Development and Child Welfare Department, Telangana portal at http://wdcw.tg.nic.in or direct MIS portal https://mis.tgwdcw.in.
Step 2: Click on 'Nagarkurnool District Anganwadi Recruitment 2026 (Notification No. 185/A/DWO-NGKL/2026)'.
Step 3: Select the appropriate ICDS Project (Achampet, Balmoor, Kalwakurthy, Kollapur, or Nagarkurnool) and the specific Gram Panchayat / Anganwadi Center.
Step 4: Enter applicant details including Name, Father's/Husband's Name, Date of Birth, SSC marks memo details, and Residential Address.
Step 5: Upload clear scanned copies of passport photograph, signature, SSC (10th) marks memo, Residence Certificate (Nativity/Panchayat Certificate), Caste Certificate, and Aadhaar card.
Step 6: Review the filled application form, verify all details, and click 'Submit'.
Step 7: Download and print the submitted application acknowledgement slip for future verification stages.

uttarakhand-subordinate-servic-personal-.applicationStatus: Online Registration Opens 14 September 2026 to 14 October 2026
overview: The Uttarakhand Subordinate Service Selection Commission (UKSSSC - उत्तराखण्ड अधीनस्थ सेवा चयन आयोग), Dehradun has officially released Advertisement No. 81/उ०अ०से०च०आ०/2026 (dated 08 September 2026) inviting online applications for direct recruitment to 101 Group 'C' (समूह 'ग') vacancies. The recruitment drive covers posts of Personal Assistant (वैयक्तिक सहायक), Stenographer (आशुलिपिक), Stenographer Grade-3 (आशुलिपिक ग्रेड-तृतीय), and Stenographer Grade-2 (आशुलिपिक ग्रेड-2 / ब्रिडकुल) across 19 departments and regional development authorities in Uttarakhand.

Pay scales for these prestigious positions span from Pay Level-04 (₹25,500 - ₹81,100) up to Pay Level-07 (₹44,900 - ₹1,42,400) under the revised 7th CPC matrix. Selection will be conducted through a 2-stage competitive process: a 100-mark OMR-based written objective exam followed by qualifying Hindi/English shorthand and typing tests in a 1:4 ratio against vacancies. Crucial date for age calculation is 01 July 2026.

Interested and eligible candidates possessing Intermediate (10+2) or Graduation along with the required Hindi/English shorthand speed (80 wpm) and computer typing speed (4000 KDPH / 25-40 wpm) can apply online via the official UKSSSC portal (https://sssc.uk.gov.in). The online registration link opens on 14 September 2026 and closes on 14 October 2026. Correction in application form will be available from 17 October 2026 to 19 October 2026, and the written test is tentatively scheduled for 20 December 2026.

overview: Staff Selection Commission (SSC), Department of Personnel and Training (DoP&T), Government of India has officially announced the Combined Higher Secondary (10+2) Level Examination, 2026 (Advt No: F. No. HQ-C1102/5/2026-C-1) on 07 September 2026, inviting online applications for approximately 2,536 tentative vacancies across Ministries, Departments, Constitutional Bodies, and Tribunals.

The recruitment drive fills prestigious Central Government Group 'C' positions including Lower Division Clerk (LDC), Junior Secretariat Assistant (JSA), Data Entry Operator (DEO), and Data Entry Operator Grade 'A'. Candidates who have passed or appeared in Class 12 (with results declared on or before 07 October 2026) within the age bracket of 18 to 27 years (as on 01 August 2026) are eligible to participate.

The selection architecture features a revised two-tier Computer Based Examination (Tier-I and Tier-II) followed by qualifying Skill / Typing Tests and Departmental Document Verification. The online application window is open from 07 September 2026 to 07 October 2026 (11:00 PM) exclusively via the Commission's new portal at ssc.gov.in.

examCentres.details: Conducted across 9 SSC Regions nationwide: Central Region (CR - Bihar & UP: Patna, Prayagraj, Lucknow, Varanasi, etc.), Eastern Region (ER - WB, Odisha, Jharkhand, A&N: Kolkata, Bhubaneswar, Ranchi), Karnataka Kerala Region (KKR: Bengaluru, Thiruvananthapuram, Kochi), Madhya Pradesh Region (MPR: Bhopal, Indore, Raipur), North Eastern Region (NER: Guwahati, Shillong, Agartala), Northern Region (NR - Delhi, Rajasthan, Uttarakhand: Delhi, Jaipur, Dehradun), North Western Sub-Region (NWR: Chandigarh, Jammu, Shimla), Southern Region (SR: Chennai, Hyderabad, Vijayawada), and Western Region (WR: Mumbai, Ahmedabad, Nagpur, Pune). Candidates must give preference for 3 centres within the same region.

selectionProcess.stage: Stage 1: Tier-I Examination (Computer Based Examination - CBE)
selectionProcess.description: Objective Multiple Choice Test comprising 100 questions (200 marks) across English Language (25 Q), General Intelligence (25 Q), Quantitative Aptitude (25 Q), and General Awareness (25 Q) in 60 minutes with 15-minute sectional timers. Negative marking of 0.50 marks per wrong answer. Normalized scores determine shortlisting for Tier-II.

selectionProcess.stage: Stage 2: Tier-II Examination (CBE - Objective & Descriptive / Knowledge)
selectionProcess.description: Session-I (2 hr 15 min): Section-I [Maths (30 Q) + Reasoning (30 Q) = 180 Marks], Section-II [English (40 Q) + GA (20 Q) = 180 Marks], Section-III [Computer Knowledge (15 Q = 45 Marks, Qualifying)]. Negative marking of 1 mark per wrong question in Sections I, II, and III.

selectionProcess.stage: Stage 3: Tier-II Session-II (Skill Test / Typing Test)
selectionProcess.description: Qualifying nature conducted on the same day as Tier-II. Part A: DEO in specified Ministries (15,000 KDPH in 15 min); Part B: DEO in other Depts (8,000 KDPH in 15 min); Part C: Typing Test for LDC/JSA (35 wpm English or 30 wpm Hindi in Mangal Font, 10 min duration).
Conducted directly by Indenting Ministries, Departments, and User Organizations after declaration of final merit list based on aggregate marks in Tier-II Sections I & II.

selectionProcess.stage: Stage 5: Physical Standards, PET & Medical (Only for BRO Posts)
selectionProcess.description: Applicable exclusively for male candidates opting for Lower Division Clerk vacancies in the Border Roads Organization (BRO). Involves 1 Mile Run in 10 minutes and region-specific physical benchmarks.

howToApplySteps: Navigate to the official Staff Selection Commission website at https://ssc.gov.in (or download the 'my SSC' Android App from Google Play Store).

Complete One-Time Registration (OTR): Candidates must register afresh on the new portal (old ssc.nic.in credentials will not work). Aadhaar-Based Authentication is strongly advised to avoid live photo and signature rejections.
Log in using your newly generated OTR Registration Number and Password.
Under the 'Latest Notifications' dashboard tab, locate 'Combined Higher Secondary (10+2) Level Examination, 2026' and click 'Apply'.
Fill in the application details, select 3 preferred examination centres within the chosen SSC Region, select exam language, and declare 12th standard stream.

Capture Live Photograph & Upload Signature: Use a webcam or mobile phone camera to capture a clear live photograph against a plain background (without cap, mask, or spectacles). Upload scanned signature in JPEG format (10 KB to 20 KB, 4.0 cm × 2.0 cm).

Preview the entire form carefully, accept the declaration, and proceed to pay the application fee of ₹100/- online (exempted for Women, SC, ST, PwBD, ESM). Submit the application before 07 October 2026 (11:00 PM) and print the confirmation page.
documentsRequired: Class 10 (Matriculation) Certificate & Mark Sheet as valid Date of Birth proof
Class 12 (Intermediate / 10+2) Certificate & Mark Sheet with Science/Maths stream if applying for Ministry DEO posts
Valid Photo ID proof (Aadhaar Card, Voter ID, PAN Card, Passport, Driving License)
Category / Caste Certificate (SC/ST/OBC-NCL/EWS) in prescribed Central Government formats
Income & Asset Certificate valid for 2026-2027 (based on FY 2025-2026) for EWS candidates
Disability Certificate (Annexure-I/IA/XI/XII) for PwBD applicants claiming reservation or scribe facility
Discharge Certificate and Undertaking (Annexure-VIII) for Ex-Servicemen (ESM)
No Objection Certificate (NOC) for Central Government Civilian Employees
importantInstructions: Crucial Dates: Age is reckoned as on 01 August 2026 (18–27 years). Educational Qualification cut-off date is 07 October 2026.
Live Photo Mandatory: Do not upload old scanned photos. Live photo must be captured directly via device camera without spectacles, cap, or mask.
BRO Posts Restriction: As per Para 4.4, only male candidates are eligible for Lower Division Clerk vacancies reported in Border Roads Organization (BRO).
Sectional Timers in Tier-I: Each of the 4 subjects has a dedicated 15-minute sectional timer (total 60 minutes). Candidates cannot switch between sections arbitrarily.
Negative Marking: 0.50 marks per wrong answer in Tier-I; 1.00 mark per wrong answer in Tier-II Sections I, II, and III.
Computer Knowledge Test & Typing Test are mandatory and qualifying in nature for final selection.
Post Preferences: Online Option Form for Ministries/Departments will be submitted on ssc.gov.in prior to final result declaration and cannot be altered subsequently.

faqs.question: What is the total number of vacancies announced for SSC CHSL Recruitment 2026?
faqs.answer: A total of approximately 2,536 tentative vacancies have been announced across Central Government Ministries, Departments, and Offices under the Combined Higher Secondary (10+2) Level Examination 2026.

faqs.question: What is the educational qualification required for SSC CHSL 2026 posts?
faqs.answer: Candidates must have passed 12th Standard (Intermediate) from a recognized Board. For Data Entry Operator (DEO) in the Ministry of Consumer Affairs, Food & Public Distribution, SSC, and Ministry of Culture, passing Class 12 in the Science stream with Mathematics is mandatory. Candidates appearing in 12th standard exams can also apply provided their results are declared by 07 October 2026.

faqs.question: What is the crucial date for age calculation in SSC CHSL 2026?
faqs.answer: The crucial date for age reckoning is 01 August 2026. Applicants must be between 18 and 27 years of age (born between 02-08-1999 and 01-08-2008). Permissible age relaxations apply for SC/ST (5 yrs), OBC (3 yrs), PwBD (10-15 yrs), and Ex-Servicemen.

faqs.question: What is the last date to apply online for SSC CHSL 2026?
faqs.answer: The online application submission window is open until 07 October 2026 (11:00 PM). The fee payment deadline is 08 October 2026 (11:00 PM), and the application correction window is scheduled from 14 October 2026 to 16 October 2026.

faqs.question: What is the application fee for SSC CHSL 2026 and who is exempted?
faqs.answer: The application fee is ₹100/- for General, OBC, and EWS male candidates. All female applicants, Scheduled Caste (SC), Scheduled Tribe (ST), Persons with Benchmark Disabilities (PwBD), and Ex-Servicemen (ESM) eligible for reservation are 100% exempted from paying any fee.

faqs.question: What is the pay scale for LDC, JSA, and DEO posts under SSC CHSL 2026?
faqs.answer: Lower Division Clerk (LDC) and Junior Secretariat Assistant (JSA) are placed in Pay Level-2 (₹19,900–₹63,200). Data Entry Operators (DEO) and DEO Grade 'A' are placed in Pay Level-4 (₹25,500–₹81,100) and Pay Level-5 (₹29,200–₹92,300) with DA, HRA, Transport Allowance, and public service benefits.

faqs.question: What is the examination pattern and marking scheme for SSC CHSL 2026 Tier-I?
faqs.answer: Tier-I is an objective Computer Based Examination comprising 100 questions (200 marks) across 4 subjects: English (25 Q), Reasoning (25 Q), Quantitative Aptitude (25 Q), and General Awareness (25 Q). Total time is 60 minutes with 15-minute sectional timers per subject. There is a negative marking of 0.50 marks per incorrect response.

faqs.question: What typing speed is required for LDC/JSA and DEO in Tier-II?
faqs.answer: For LDC/JSA, candidates must achieve 35 w.p.m. in English or 30 w.p.m. in Hindi (Mangal font) in a 10-minute test. For DEO in specific Ministries, data entry speed is 15,000 Key Depressions Per Hour (15 min test); for DEO in other departments, the speed is 8,000 Key Depressions Per Hour (15 min test).

overview: Department of Posts, Ministry of Communications, Government of India (GDS Section) has officially published employment notification No. 17-12/2026-GDS dated 20 August 2026 for Gramin Dak Sevak (GDS) Online Engagement Schedule-II, July-2026. The national recruitment drive invites online applications to fill 23,757 tentative vacancies across Postal Circles for the posts of Branch Postmaster (BPM), Assistant Branch Postmaster (ABPM), and Dak Sevak.

Candidates who have passed 10th Standard (Secondary School Examination) with Mathematics and English from any recognized School Education Board and have studied the local language up to Class 10th are eligible to apply. Applicants must be between 18 and 40 years of age as on the closing date (21 September 2026). Selection is 100% merit-based, generated automatically by the portal on the basis of Class 10th marks/grades. There is NO written examination and NO interview.

Selected Gramin Dak Sevaks receive monthly Time Related Continuity Allowance (TRCA) slabs of ₹12,000 - ₹29,380 for BPM and ₹10,000 - ₹24,470 for ABPM/Dak Sevak, along with annual increments, Dearness Allowance (DA), GDS Gratuity, and Service Discharge Benefit Scheme (SDBS) benefits. Applications must be submitted through the official portal https://indiapost.gov.in/gdsonlineengagement before 21 September 2026 (17:00 Hrs).

selectionProcess.stage: Stage 1: Online One-Time Registration (OTR) & Application Submission

howToApply: Step 1: Visit the official India Post GDS Engagement portal: https://indiapost.gov.in/gdsonlineengagement.
Step 2: Complete Stage 1 One-Time Registration (OTR) by validating your mobile number and email ID via OTP, and entering your Name, Father's Name, DOB, Gender, and 10th Passing details.
Step 3: Note down your generated Registration Number and password received via SMS.
Step 4: Log in under 'Apply Online' and select your designated Postal Circle and Division.
Step 5: Fill in your subject-wise Class 10th marks/grades and select your Post Preferences in order of priority.
Step 6: Upload your recent photograph (JPG, 30-100 KB, 320x400 px) and scanned signature in black/blue ink (JPG, 20-100 KB, 300x120 px).
Step 7: Pay the application fee of ₹100/- online (exempted for Women, SC, ST, PwBD, and Transwomen applicants).
Step 8: Preview the completed application form, submit before 21 September 2026 (17:00 Hrs), and take a printout of the confirmation page.
Step 9: If needed, utilize the 2-day edit/correction window available from 23 September 2026 to 24 September 2026.
documentsRequired: Secondary School Examination (Class 10th) Marksheet and Passing Certificate (mandatory DOB & marks proof).
Consent and declaration for mark sheet verification through DigiLocker / API Setu (Annexure-X).
Recent Passport Size Color Photograph (30 KB to 100 KB, JPG format).
Scanned Signature on white paper with black or blue pen (20 KB to 100 KB, JPG format).
Caste / Community Certificate (SC/ST/OBC-NCL) in prescribed central format (Annexure-V).
EWS Income & Asset Certificate issued by competent authority in prescribed format.
PwBD Disability Certificate (UDID) issued by Medical Authority.
Medical Fitness Certificate issued by Government Medical Officer / Primary Health Centre.
Certificate of proficiency in tribal/local dialects (for Arunachal Pradesh, Sikkim, Goa, or Nagaland).
Mandatory undertakings: Non-dismissal (Annexure-IV), Computer literacy (Annexure-VI), Cycling ability (Annexure-VII), and Adequate Means of Livelihood (Annexure-VIII).
importantInstructions: Candidates can apply for multiple posts within ONLY ONE selected Postal Division.
Only one registration is permitted per candidate; duplicate registrations are strictly prohibited and will lead to disqualification.
Marks in Class 10th are the sole criteria for merit; no weightage is given to higher qualifications or past experience.
Selected BPMs must arrange branch post office accommodation in the post village at their own expense.
Applicants must possess a functional Digilocker account with 10th marksheet and caste certificate fetched for API Setu online verification.
The engagement process will be officially closed on 31 December 2026; no supplementary lists will be released thereafter.

bank-of-baroda-so-wealth-executive-credi.jobLocation: All India (Liable to be posted anywhere in India)
overview: Bank of Baroda (BOB), one of India's premier public sector commercial banks, has officially released recruitment notification Advt No. BOB/HRM/REC/ADVT/2026/17 for regular human resource appointments across specialized departments. The drive invites online applications for a total of 1100 Specialist Officer vacancies, comprising 1000 posts of Wealth Executive (JMG/S-I) under Wealth Management Services and 100 posts of Credit Analyst – C&IC (MMG/S-II) under Corporate & Institutional Credit.

Candidates possessing a Bachelor's Degree in any discipline with mandatory professional certifications (IC 38 / NISM Series V-A, XXI-A, or V-D) and 2 years relevant sales experience can apply for Wealth Executive. For Credit Analyst, applicants must hold a Graduation degree along with Chartered Accountant (CA) qualification and at least 1 year banking experience in a Scheduled Commercial Bank. The crucial eligibility cut-off date for age, education, and experience is 01 September 2026.

Selected officers will receive competitive industry-standard scales of pay (Basic Pay ₹48,480 - ₹85,920 for Scale-I and ₹64,820 - ₹93,960 for Scale-II) plus DA, HRA, CCA, perquisites, and bank-specific allowances. The selection framework comprises Application Scrutiny, Online Computer-Based Test (120 Questions/120 Marks), Psychometric Assessment, and Personal Interview. The online application portal is open from 04 September 2026 to 24 September 2026.

howToApply: Step 1: Visit the official Bank of Baroda careers portal at https://www.bankofbaroda.bank.in/career.htm or the direct IBPS registration link https://ibpsreg.ibps.in/bonwejul26/.
Step 2: Click on 'Current Opportunities' and locate advertisement BOB/HRM/REC/ADVT/2026/17.
Step 3: Register by providing your active email ID, mobile number, and basic demographic credentials.
Step 4: Fill in detailed educational qualification details (Class 10th, 12th, Graduation, CA / NISM / IC-38 certifications) and relevant employment experience.
Step 5: Upload required digital documents: Resume (PDF <= 500 KB), DOB Proof (10th marksheet), consolidated educational certificates, experience letters, and category certificate (if applicable).
Step 6: Upload passport photograph (20-50 KB), live webcam photo capture, signature in black ink (10-20 KB), left-thumb impression (20-50 KB), and handwritten declaration (50-100 KB).
Step 7: Pay the application fee online (₹850 for General/EWS/OBC; ₹175 for SC/ST/PwBD/Women) via Debit/Credit Card, Net Banking, or UPI.
Step 8: Submit the completed application form before 24 September 2026 and print the generated e-receipt and application acknowledgment slip.

faqs.question: What is the educational qualification and experience for Wealth Executive in BOB?
faqs.answer: Candidates must possess a Bachelor's Degree in any discipline along with a valid certification in IC 38 or NISM Series (V-A, XXI-A, or V-D), plus a minimum of 2 years post-qualification experience in wealth product sales. An MBA or PG Diploma in Management is preferred.

postgraduate-institute-of-medi-nursing-o.board: Postgraduate Institute of Medical Education & Research (PGIMER), Chandigarh
overview: Postgraduate Institute of Medical Education & Research (PGIMER), Chandigarh, an Institute of National Importance (INI) under the Ministry of Health & Family Welfare, Government of India, has officially announced recruitment notification Advt No. PGI/RC/055/2026/2276 dated 09 September 2026. The institute invites online applications from eligible Indian citizens for direct recruitment to 243 posts of Nursing Officer (Group 'B') earmarked for the newly established Advanced Mother & Child (MCH) Centre at PGIMER, Chandigarh.

Candidates possessing B.Sc. (Hons) Nursing, regular B.Sc. Nursing, or Post Basic B.Sc. Nursing from a recognized University/Institute with valid State Nursing Council registration (RN/RM) are eligible. Candidates holding a Diploma in General Nursing and Midwifery (GNM) with State Nursing Council registration and at least 1 year clinical experience in a minimum 50-bedded hospital are also eligible. The prescribed age bracket is 18 to 35 years as on the crucial closing date of 03 October 2026.

Selected Nursing Officers will be placed in Pay Level-7 of the 7th CPC Pay Matrix (₹44,900 - ₹1,42,400/-) with attractive central allowances including DA, HRA, Nursing Allowance (₹7,200/mo), Uniform Allowance, and medical coverage. Selection is based purely on merit obtained in the Computer Based Test (100 MCQs, 100 Minutes, 100 Marks) with strictly NO interview. The online application portal is active on www.pgimer.edu.in from 10 September 2026 to 03 October 2026.

howToApply: Step 1: Visit the official PGIMER website: https://pgimer.edu.in.
Step 2: Navigate to 'Recruitment' link on the Home Page and select advertisement PGI/RC/055/2026/2276 for Nursing Officer posts.
Step 3: Complete Online Registration with your Name, Date of Birth, Email ID, and Mobile Number as recorded in your 10th matriculation certificate.
Step 4: Log in with the received User ID and Password, and fill in personal details, educational qualifications, nursing registration details, and experience.

Step 5: Upload clear scanned copies of documents: Matriculation certificate (DOB proof), B.Sc. Nursing / GNM degree certificates, State Nursing Council Registration Certificate (RN/RM), hospital experience certificate (for GNM), and Category/EWS certificate.
Step 6: Upload recent passport size colour photograph (50-80 KB, JPEG, snapped on or after 01.07.2026 with candidate name and date of photo printed at the bottom) and scanned signature.
Step 7: Pay the application fee online (₹1,500 for Gen/OBC/EWS; ₹800 for SC/ST; Free for PwBD) using Net Banking, Debit Card, or Credit Card.
Step 8: Review all entries, submit the online form before 03 October 2026, and download/print the completed application confirmation for future reference.

faqs.question: What is the total number of Nursing Officer vacancies in PGIMER Chandigarh 2026?
faqs.answer: A total of 243 Nursing Officer (Group 'B') vacancies have been announced for the Advanced Mother & Child (MCH) Centre at PGIMER Chandigarh (UR: 99, OBC: 66, SC: 36, ST: 18, EWS: 24, PwBD: 10).

faqs.question: What is the educational qualification required for PGIMER Nursing Officer?
faqs.answer: Candidates must have B.Sc. (Hons) Nursing, regular B.Sc. Nursing, or Post Basic B.Sc. Nursing with State Nursing Council registration (RN/RM). Alternatively, candidates with a GNM Diploma registered with a State Nursing Council AND 1 year clinical experience in a minimum 50-bedded hospital are also eligible.

faqs.question: What is the pay scale for Nursing Officer in PGIMER Chandigarh?
faqs.answer: The post carries Level-7 in the 7th CPC Pay Matrix with a basic pay of ₹44,900/- (pay scale ₹44,900 - ₹1,42,400/-). Total monthly gross compensation is approximately ₹78,000 - ₹88,000/- including Nursing Allowance (₹7,200/mo), DA, HRA, and Uniform Allowance.

faqs.question: Is there any interview for PGIMER Nursing Officer selection?
faqs.answer: No. The Government of India has dispensed with interviews for Group 'B' non-gazetted posts. Final selection is made 100% on the basis of marks obtained in the online Computer Based Test (CBT).

faqs.question: What is the scheme and marking pattern of the PGIMER Nursing Officer CBT?
faqs.answer: The CBT consists of 100 multiple choice questions (MCQs) for 100 marks to be completed in 100 minutes in English language. There is negative marking of 0.25 marks for each wrong answer. Minimum qualifying marks are 40% for General/EWS and 35% for SC/ST/OBC.

faqs.question: What is the last date to apply online for PGIMER Nursing Officer Recruitment 2026?
faqs.answer: Online applications can be submitted on www.pgimer.edu.in from 10 September 2026 until 03 October 2026.

Candidates meeting the prescribed eligibility conditions (Coordinator Grade-I: Master's degree with at least 55% marks; nine years' experience as Assistant Professor in Academic ...) and age requirements can submit their candidature via Apply Online. The closing deadline / scheduled date is 19 October 2026 (23:59:59 hrs).

Selected appointees will be stationed in Lucknow (Main Campus) and Amethi (Satellite Centre), Uttar Pradesh, receiving official compensation (As per official institutional pay scale rules), statutory allowances, and established public service benefits as per organizational regulations.

vacanciesDetails.qualification: Coordinator Grade-I: Master's degree with at least 55% marks; nine years' experience as Assistant Professor in Academic Level 10 and above with educational administration experience, or comparable research/higher education institution experience, or five years' administrative experience as Assistant Registrar or equivalent. Desirable: experience in Establishment/Examinations/Finance. Assistant Librarian: Master's degree in Library Science/Information Science/Documentation Science or equivalent with at least 55% marks; consistently good academic record with knowledge of library computerization; must have cleared NET (UGC/CSIR) or SLET/SET, or hold a Ph.D. as per UGC (M.Phil./Ph.D.) Regulations, 2009 or 2016, subject to specified exemption conditions. System Analyst: First class M.E./M.Tech. (Computer Science & Technology/Information Technology)/MCA/M.Sc. (Computer Science/Information Technology) or equivalent; OR First class B.E./B.Tech. (Computer Science & Technology/Information Technology) or equivalent with two years' relevant experience. Desirable: CCNA/CCNP or equivalent certification. Library Assistant: Bachelor's degree in Library & Information Science or equivalent; typing speed of 30 words per minute in English; knowledge of computer applications. Professor (Economics, Human Rights, Public Administration, Demographic Studies): Ph.D. with 10 research publications and a total research score of 120 as per UGC 2018 norms, and 10 years' teaching/research experience with evidence of guiding doctoral candidates; OR an outstanding professional with a Ph.D. and 10 years' relevant experience. Professor - Law: LL.M. and Ph.D. in Law, plus other UGC 2018 conditions for Professor. Professor - Civil/Electronics & Communication Engineering: Ph.D. in the relevant field with first class at Bachelor's or Master's level; minimum 10 years' teaching/research/industry experience (at least 3 years as Associate Professor); at least 6 SCI/UGC/AICTE-listed publications at Associate Professor level with 2 successful Ph.D. supervisions, OR 10 such publications. Associate Professor (Human Development & Family Studies, Hindi): Ph.D. in the relevant discipline; Master's with at least 55% marks; 8 years' teaching/research experience with 7 peer-reviewed publications and a research score of 75 as per UGC 2018 norms. Assistant Professor - English: Master's degree with 55% marks and NET/SLET/SET (or Ph.D. as per UGC exemption conditions), OR a Ph.D. from a foreign university ranked in the top 500 globally (QS/THE/ARWU). Assistant Professor - Education (as per NCTE Regulations): Postgraduate degree in Social Sciences (55%) + M.Ed. (55%), OR PG in Education (55%) + B.Ed./B.El.Ed. (55%); plus UGC-NET/JRF/Ph.D. in Education. For Curriculum & Pedagogic subjects, a relevant PG subject + M.Ed. (55% each) is required; for Music/Fine Arts, only a PG degree in the subject with 55% marks is required. Professor-cum-Resident Director: Same eligibility as Professor (Category A or B above) plus three years of administrative experience for direct recruitment; for deputation, holding an analogous Academic Level-14 post, or at least 3 years in Academic Level-13A and above as Associate Professor or equivalent. Associate Professor-cum-Deputy Director (CSSI): Ph.D. in any Social Science subject; Master's with 55% marks; 8 years' relevant experience with 7 publications and a research score of 75. Assistant Professor-cum-Assistant Director (CSSI): Master's degree in Social Science with 55% marks and NET/SLET/SET (or Ph.D. exemption as per UGC norms), OR a foreign-university Ph.D. ranked in the top 500 globally. Detailed, post-wise UGC 2018 eligibility clauses (including NET/SLET/SET exemption conditions for Ph.D. holders) are given in full in the official notification and should be read carefully before applying.

Assistant Librarian: Master's degree in Library Science/Information Science/Documentation Science or equivalent with at least 55% marks; consistently good academic record with knowledge of library computerization; must have cleared NET (UGC/CSIR) or SLET/SET, or hold a Ph.D. as per UGC (M.Phil./Ph.D.) Regulations, 2009 or 2016, subject to specified exemption conditions. System Analyst: First class M.E./M.Tech. (Computer Science & Technology/Information Technology)/MCA/M.Sc. (Computer Science/Information Technology) or equivalent; OR First class B.E./B.Tech. (Computer Science & Technology/Information Technology) or equivalent with two years' relevant experience. Desirable: CCNA/CCNP or equivalent certification. Library Assistant: Bachelor's degree in Library & Information Science or equivalent; typing speed of 30 words per minute in English; knowledge of computer applications. Professor (Economics, Human Rights, Public Administration, Demographic Studies): Ph.D. with 10 research publications and a total research score of 120 as per UGC 2018 norms, and 10 years' teaching/research experience with evidence of guiding doctoral candidates; OR an outstanding professional with a Ph.D. and 10 years' relevant experience. Professor - Law: LL.M. and Ph.D. in Law, plus other UGC 2018 conditions for Professor. Professor - Civil/Electronics & Communication Engineering: Ph.D. in the relevant field with first class at Bachelor's or Master's level; minimum 10 years' teaching/research/industry experience (at least 3 years as Associate Professor); at least 6 SCI/UGC/AICTE-listed publications at Associate Professor level with 2 successful Ph.D. supervisions, OR 10 such publications. Associate Professor (Human Development & Family Studies, Hindi): Ph.D. in the relevant discipline; Master's with at least 55% marks; 8 years' teaching/research experience with 7 peer-reviewed publications and a research score of 75 as per UGC 2018 norms. Assistant Professor - English: Master's degree with 55% marks and NET/SLET/SET (or Ph.D. as per UGC exemption conditions), OR a Ph.D. from a foreign university ranked in the top 500 globally (QS/THE/ARWU). Assistant Professor - Education (as per NCTE Regulations): Postgraduate degree in Social Sciences (55%) + M.Ed. (55%), OR PG in Education (55%) + B.Ed./B.El.Ed. (55%); plus UGC-NET/JRF/Ph.D. in Education. For Curriculum & Pedagogic subjects, a relevant PG subject + M.Ed. (55% each) is required; for Music/Fine Arts, only a PG degree in the subject with 55% marks is required. Professor-cum-Resident Director: Same eligibility as Professor (Category A or B above) plus three years of administrative experience for direct recruitment; for deputation, holding an analogous Academic Level-14 post, or at least 3 years in Academic Level-13A and above as Associate Professor or equivalent. Associate Professor-cum-Deputy Director (CSSI): Ph.D. in any Social Science subject; Master's with 55% marks; 8 years' relevant experience with 7 publications and a research score of 75. Assistant Professor-cum-Assistant Director (CSSI): Master's degree in Social Science with 55% marks and NET/SLET/SET (or Ph.D. exemption as per UGC norms), OR a foreign-university Ph.D. ranked in the top 500 globally. Detailed, post-wise UGC 2018 eligibility clauses (including NET/SLET/SET exemption conditions for Ph.D. holders) are given in full in the official notification and should be read carefully before applying.

overview: Office of the District Programme Officer, Gautam Buddha Nagar (Bal Vikas Seva Evam Pushtahar, Government of Uttar Pradesh) has officially released employment advertisement notification (Letter No. सी/530/जि0का0अ0/आ0वा0का0/सहा0चयन भर्ती/2026-27, dated 07 September 2026) for direct recruitment of 267 contractual vacancies of Anganwadi Karyakatri (Worker - 84 Posts) and Anganwadi Sahayika (Helper - 183 Posts) across urban and rural project blocks in Gautam Buddha Nagar district.

Eligible female candidates possessing minimum Intermediate (12th Class) qualification and aged between 18 to 35 years as on 01 July 2026 can apply online via the official portal http://upanganwadibharti.in. Selection is purely merit-based determined on marks obtained from Intermediate up to Post Graduation. There is NO written examination or personal interview.

Applicants must be permanent local residents of the concerned Gram Sabha (for rural projects) or specific Ward (for urban projects). Priority will be accorded to Below Poverty Line (BPL) applicants, widows, and legally divorced/abandoned women. The deadline for online submission is 28 September 2026 (Midnight 12:00 AM).

Eligible female candidates who have passed Intermediate (12th Class) and are aged between 18 and 35 years as on 01 July 2026 can submit their application online through the official portal http://upanganwadibharti.in. In accordance with UP Government Order No. 1/1092245/2025/3313/58-1-2025 (197687) dated 17 September 2025, selection is 100% direct merit-based on marks obtained from Intermediate up to Post Graduation, with strictly NO written examination or personal interview.

Applicants must be permanent residents of the vacant Gram Sabha (for rural areas) or the specific Municipal Ward (for urban areas). Rigorous priority is accorded to Below Poverty Line (BPL) families (annual income up to ₹46,080 in rural areas and ₹56,460 in urban areas), with top preference granted to widows and legally divorced or deserted women. The deadline to apply online is 29 September 2026.

detailsList: Gender Quota: 100% reserved exclusively for Female candidates.
Strict Priority Hierarchy 1: Widow of a family living Below Poverty Line (BPL) from the same Gram Sabha / Ward.
Strict Priority Hierarchy 2: Legally Divorced or Deserted/Abandoned (परित्यक्ता) woman of a BPL family from the same Gram Sabha / Ward (with valid court order).
Strict Priority Hierarchy 3: Other female applicants belonging to BPL families of the same Gram Sabha / Ward.

Above Poverty Line (APL) Consideration: If no eligible candidate is found under BPL categories, selection proceeds to APL candidates in the same priority sequence: (a) APL Widows, (b) APL Divorced/Deserted women, (c) other APL women of the same Gram Sabha / Ward.

howToApply: Visit the official Uttar Pradesh Anganwadi Bharti portal: http://upanganwadibharti.in.

Select 'Bareilly' district and choose your respective Child Development Project block (e.g., Alampur Jafrabad, Baheri, Bhojipura, Bhuta, Bithri Chainpur, Faridpur, Fatehganj Pashchimi, Kyara, Majhgawan, Mirganj, Nawabganj, Ramnagar, Shergarh, or Bareilly Nagar).
Select your designated vacant Gram Sabha (rural) or Municipal Ward (urban).
Fill in the online form with your personal, contact, category, and educational details.

Upload clear, legible self-attested scanned copies of required documents: Class 10th marksheet (DOB proof), Class 12th marksheet, Graduation/PG marksheets (if applicable), SDM digitally signed Domicile Certificate, and Tehsildar digitally signed Income & Caste certificates.
Widow candidates must upload husband's death certificate and certified Parivar Panjika copy; divorced/deserted candidates must upload legal court order.
Ensure your Income Certificate is not older than 3 years from the date of notification and conforms to UP Revenue guidelines.
Verify all details thoroughly before final submission. Offline or postal applications will NOT be accepted under any circumstances.
Submit the online form before the closing date: 29 September 2026 and download/print the acknowledgment receipt.
For further inquiries, candidates can check notice boards at Collectorate, Vikas Bhawan, Tehsil, BDO, and CDPO offices in Bareilly.

Intermediate (Class 12th) Marksheet and Certificate (minimum mandatory qualification).

For Widows: Death Certificate of husband and certified copy of Family Register (परिवार पंजिका नकल) issued by Gram Panchayat Officer or Urban Local Body.
For Divorced / Abandoned Women: Certified legal court order / decree issued by competent judicial court.
Recent passport size color photograph and scanned signature of the candidate.
Valid government Photo Identity Proof (Aadhaar Card, Voter ID).
importantInstructions: Only female candidates are eligible to apply; male candidates are not eligible.

The applicant MUST be a permanent resident of the vacant Gram Sabha (rural area) or vacant Ward (urban area). In rural areas, if no candidate is found in the Gram Sabha, the concerned Nyaya Panchayat pool is considered.

vacanciesDetails.qualification: For most subjects (Hindi, English, Economics, Sociology, Physics, Chemistry, Mathematics, Commerce, Botany, History, Philosophy, Zoology, Psychology, Political Science, Education, Sanskrit, Home Science, Geography, Physical Education, Military Science, Agriculture-related subjects, Law, Statistics, Geology, and others), eligibility is either: Route A: A Master's degree with 55% marks (or equivalent grade) in the relevant/allied subject from an Indian university (or an equivalent degree from an accredited foreign university), AND a qualifying NET conducted by UGC/CSIR, or an equivalent state-level test (SLET/SET) accredited by UGC - subject to exemption for candidates awarded a PhD as per UGC (Minimum Standards for Award of M.Phil./Ph.D. Degree) Regulations, 2009 or 2016 (and subsequent amendments), provided specified conditions relating to regular-mode PhD, external examiners, open viva-voce, published papers, and presented conference papers are met and certified by the university. Route B: A PhD in the relevant subject obtained (at any time) from a foreign university/institution ranked in the world's top 500 as per QS World University Rankings, Times Higher Education (THE), or Shanghai Jiao Tong University (Shanghai) rankings. For Art/Drawing & Painting, Music Vocal, Music Instrumental (Sitar), and Music Instrumental (Tabla), eligibility is either the same Master's + NET/SLET/SET or PhD route as above, OR a traditional/professional artist with a Bachelor's degree and outstanding professional achievement in the relevant discipline, having studied under recognized traditional masters/artists, having been an "A" grade artist on All India Radio/Doordarshan, and possessing the ability to teach the subject with sound theoretical grounding - subject to a minimum 55% qualifying marks requirement at Master's level for direct recruitment purposes. A relaxation of 5% in qualifying marks (from 55% to 50%) applies to SC/ST/OBC(non-creamy layer)/disabled category candidates (as specified in the notification) for the purpose of eligibility and evaluation of academic record for direct recruitment. A further 5% relaxation (55% to 50%) applies to PhD-degree holders who obtained their degree before 19 September 1991. A grade considered equivalent to 55% at Master's level under any UGC-recognized university's grading system is also treated as valid. The official advertisement also lists subject-wise inter-related/equivalent subjects (Antarsambandh Vishay) accepted for eligibility against several subjects (e.g., Hindi accepts Linguistics; History accepts Medieval History, Modern History, Ancient History, Archaeology; Sociology accepts Social Work; Economics accepts Applied Economics) - candidates should verify the equivalent-subject list for their subject in the official notification.
